title: BFMTrack: Latent Sequence Optimization for Physics-Based Motion Tracking with Behavioral Foundation Models
summary: Behavioral Foundation Models (BFMs) offer a promising path toward universal physics-based character control by organizing a rich repertoire of physically plausible behaviors into a latent space, guided by a large-scale motion dataset. While these models excel at time-invariant tasks, such as goal-reaching and state-based reward optimization, their latent space does not directly support time-varying objectives, such as tracking a motion sequence. For tracking, existing heuristics rely on moving-window-averaging that fails to capture the nuances of highly dynamic motions. In this work, we propose a novel Latent Sequence Optimization (LSO) to address these shortcomings. Our approach combines simulation rollouts with a policy gradient update to optimize over a sequence of latents, extending the capabilities of BFMs toward precise motion tracking without requiring reward engineering and tuning. To guide the optimization toward smooth, coherent latent trajectories, we model the latent sequence using temporally correlated noise. We validate our approach across dense tracking, sparse keyframing, and direct deployment onto a real humanoid robot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出潜在序列优化（LSO）方法，通过结合模拟 rollout 和策略梯度更新优化潜在序列，使行为基础模型（BFMs）能够精确跟踪运动序列，无需奖励工程，并在密集跟踪、稀疏关键帧和真实人形机器人部署上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有BFMs在时不变任务（如目标到达）上表现优异，但其潜在空间无法直接支持时变目标（如运动序列跟踪）。现有的移动窗口平均启发式方法无法捕捉高度动态运动的细微变化。
AI.method: 提出Latent Sequence Optimization (LSO)：结合模拟rollout与策略梯度更新，优化潜在序列以实现精确运动跟踪；通过时间相关噪声建模潜在序列，引导优化生成平滑连贯的潜在轨迹，无需奖励工程和调参。
AI.result: 在密集跟踪、稀疏关键帧任务中取得良好效果，并成功直接部署到真实人形机器人上。
AI.conclusion: LSO有效扩展了BFMs的能力边界，使其能够处理时变运动跟踪任务，且无需繁琐的奖励设计，为通用物理角色控制提供了新范式。

title: Invariant Kalman filtering for extended pose estimation in multi-IMU articulated rigid-body systems
summary: Accurate extended pose estimation (orientation, velocity, and position) for IMU-instrumented articulated rigid-body systems is a key challenge in robotics and human motion analysis. The invariant extended Kalman filter (IEKF) addresses this problem for a single rigid body with convergence guarantees and consistency under unobservability, but extending these properties to articulated systems is nontrivial: inter-body pose coupling prevents a direct application, and incorporating joint kinematic constraints within the invariant framework remains an open problem. To address this gap, we introduce the relative L-extended pose, a Lie group representation for kinematic-tree systems. With one IMU per body, it yields group-affine dynamics and allows joint constraints to be expressed in invariant form. We incorporate these constraints as noise-free pseudo-measurements within an iterated IEKF (IterIEKF), thereby preserving the convergence and consistency guarantees of invariant filtering. Validated on both a UR5e robot and a human leg, the proposed IterIEKF outperforms all EKF, IterEKF, and absolute-pose IterIEKF baselines. It converges faster, exhibits lower run-to-run variability, and consistently achieves the lowest RMSE, with reductions of at least 50% compared to the second-best filter across all scenarios considered in this work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于相对L-扩展位姿的迭代不变扩展卡尔曼滤波（IterIEKF）方法，用于IMU装备的铰接刚体系统的精确位姿估计，在UR5e机器人和人体腿部验证中实现了比现有方法至少50%的RMSE降低。
AI.motivation: IEKF对单刚体系统具有收敛保证和一致性，但将其扩展到铰接系统面临挑战：体间位姿耦合使得直接应用困难，且如何在不变框架内融入关节运动学约束仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 提出相对L-扩展位姿的Lie群表示，使每个刚体配备一个IMU的系统具有群仿射动态，并将关节约束表达为不变形式；将这些约束作为无噪声伪测量融入迭代IEKF（IterIEKF）中。
AI.result: 在UR5e机器人和人体腿部上验证，IterIEKF在所有场景中均优于EKF、IterEKF和绝对位姿IterIEKF基线，收敛更快、运行间变异性更低，RMSE至少降低50%。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法成功将不变滤波的收敛和一致性保证扩展至铰接多刚体系统，为机器人及人体运动分析中的精确位姿估计提供了有效解决方案。

title: ADM-Fusion: Adaptive Deep Multi-Sensor Fusion for Robust Ego-Motion Estimation in Diverse Conditions
summary: Robust multi-sensor fusion is essential for reliable autonomy in diverse and degraded environments, where sensor reliability can fluctuate rapidly. Because different modalities fail in distinct ways, effective fusion should adaptively balance complementary cues rather than rely on fixed weighting. This adaptability is particularly important for ego-motion estimation, since accurate updates depend on the consistent integration of complementary sensor information. We propose ADM-Fusion, an end-to-end deep learning based multi-sensor fusion method designed to adapt to environmental changes and sensor degradation. ADM-Fusion employs an adaptive sensor mixture-of-experts framework with content-aware routing to dynamically assign weights to sensor inputs in real time. The system further incorporates separate translation and rotation branches, coupled through a cross-task attention mechanism to preserve task-specific specialization while enabling information sharing. ADM-Fusion is trained on the CARLA-LOC simulated dataset and subsequently fine-tuned on KITTI real-world data, demonstrating effective simulation-to-real transfer. Experiments show that ADM-Fusion remains robust under degraded conditions while maintaining competitive performance against existing methods.

AI.tldr: ADM-Fusion是一种端到端深度学习多传感器融合方法，采用自适应传感器混合专家框架和内容感知路由，结合跨任务注意力机制，在仿真和真实数据上实现了对传感器退化环境的鲁棒位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 不同传感器在不同环境下以不同方式失效，传统固定权重的融合方法无法自适应地平衡互补线索，特别是在自运动估计任务中，需要根据环境变化和传感器退化动态调整融合策略。
AI.method: 提出ADM-Fusion方法，包含：(1)自适应传感器混合专家框架(content-aware routing)实现实时动态权重分配；(2)分离的平移和旋转分支，通过跨任务注意力机制保持任务特异性并允许信息共享；(3)在CARLA-LOC仿真数据集训练后在KITTI真实数据上微调，实现Sim-to-Real迁移。
AI.result: 在退化条件下保持鲁棒性，同时与现有方法相比具有竞争力的性能，成功实现了仿真到真实的迁移学习。
AI.conclusion: ADM-Fusion通过自适应融合和跨任务注意力机制，有效解决了多传感器融合在退化环境中的鲁棒性问题，验证了仿真训练+真实微调范式的可行性。

title: SurveilNav: Collaborative Object Goal Navigation with Robot and Surveillance System
summary: With the growing deployment of surveillance systems in factories, offices, and homes, integrating them with robots offers a promising direction for collaborative and efficient task execution. However, existing approaches largely focus on single-robot scenarios and struggle with multi-view collaboration in large-scale environments. In this paper, we present a novel indoor collaborative object navigation dataset built on Habitat-Sim, featuring 206 cameras across 74 floors. The dataset enables systematic evaluation of an agent's ability to exploit multi-view surveillance information. To address the limitations of single-robot perception, we propose SurveilNav, a collaborative navigation framework that integrates active camera scheduling, joint 2D/3D mapping, VLM-based value estimation, and collaborative target verification. By synergizing the robot's dynamic local perception with the static global view of surveillance, this architecture effectively overcomes both the limited perception range of single agents and the inherent blind spots of fixed cameras, resolving inefficient exploration. Experimental results on the HM3D dataset demonstrate that SurveilNav substantially outperforms existing methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance in both exploration efficiency and navigation success rate. Moreover, the system shows strong potential for applications in large-scale search, home environments, and rescue missions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于Habitat-Sim构建的室内协同目标导航数据集（含206个摄像头、74层），并设计了SurveilNav协同导航框架，通过主动相机调度、联合2D/3D建图、VLM价值估计和协同目标验证，显著提升了探索效率和导航成功率，在HM3D数据集上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多聚焦于单机器人场景，难以在多视角协作的大规模环境中有效工作；固定监控摄像头存在固有盲区，单机器人感知范围有限，导致探索效率低下。
AI.method: SurveilNav框架包含四个模块：主动相机调度、联合2D/3D建图、基于VLM的价值估计以及协同目标验证，将机器人动态局部感知与监控静态全局视图进行协同。
AI.result: 在HM3D数据集上，SurveilNav在探索效率和导航成功率方面均显著优于现有方法，达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 该协同导航架构有效克服了单机器人感知范围有限和固定相机盲区的问题，在大型搜索、家庭环境和救援任务中展现出良好的应用潜力。

title: SEMIR: Topology-Preserving Graph Minors for Thin-Structure Segmentation
comment: Accepted to the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: Thin-structure segmentation--power lines, cracks, lane markings at 1-3 pixel width--requires preserving connectivity that standard representations preclude: patching severs continuous structures and conventional superpixels merge thin targets into background before classification. Topology-aware losses penalize connectivity breaks at the objective level but cannot recover what the representation has already destroyed. We propose SEMIR, a framework that replaces the pixel lattice with a parameterized graph minor whose contraction map preserves thin-structure connectivity under the contraction criterion. The minor collapses millions of pixels into tens or hundreds of boundary-aligned supernodes, enabling full-resolution inference without patching at scales demonstrated up to 21 MP in this paper; a lightweight GNN classifies the reduced graph and an exact map lifts predictions to pixel resolution. One pipeline--identical architecture, features, loss, and GNN hyperparameters across all dataset--matches or exceeds domain-specific baselines on TTPLA (power lines), CrackSeg9k (pavement cracks), and SkyScapes Lane (aerial markings) on Dice, IoU, and Boundary F1 while reducing mask fragmentation by at least 4.6x relative to SLIC at matched inference.

AI.tldr: 提出SEMIR框架，用参数化图小图代替像素网格，通过图收缩保持薄结构连通性，在不分块情况下实现全分辨率推理，在多个数据集上优于基线并减少掩膜碎片化。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（如分块、超像素）在分割薄结构时破坏其连通性，拓扑感知损失虽惩罚断连但无法修复由表示本身造成的破坏。
AI.method: SEMIR用参数化图小图替换像素网格，通过收缩准则保持薄结构连通性；将数百万像素坍缩为数十/数百个边界对齐超节点；轻量级GNN分类缩减图，再通过精确映射将预测提升至像素级分辨率。
AI.result: 在TTPLA、CrackSeg9k、SkyScapes Lane数据集上匹配或超越领域特定基线（Dice、IoU、Boundary F1），掩膜碎片化相比SLIC降低至少4.6倍，支持高达21MP的全分辨率推理。
AI.conclusion: SEMIR通过图小图表示从根本解决了薄结构分割中连通性保持问题，通用性强，无需分块即可高效推理。

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Agentic AI: From Foundations to Systems
summary: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Agentic AI is a comprehensive practitioner's reference for building autonomous AI systems. The book covers the full stack from first principles to production deployment, organized around a central thesis: building great agentic systems requires understanding every layer of the pipeline, not just one. The book opens with the LLM substrate -- transformer architecture, GPU systems, training and fine-tuning (SFT,LoRA, MoE), model compression, and inference optimization -- treated as essential foundations rather than the primary focus. It then develops the alignment and reasoning layer: reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), PPO, DPO and its variants, GRPO, reward modeling, and RL for large reasoning models including chain-of-thought and test-time scaling. The second half is devoted to agentic AI proper. Topics include agentic training and trajectory-based RL, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG and Agentic RAG), memory systems (in-context, external, episodic, and semantic), agent harness design and context management, and a taxonomy of agent design patterns. Inter-agent coordination is covered in depth: the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent skills and tool use, the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication protocol, and multi-agent architectures spanning centralized, decentralized, and hierarchical topologies. The book concludes with agent development frameworks, agentic UI design, evaluation methodology for agentic tasks, and production deployment. Each chapter pairs rigorous theoretical foundations with implementation guidance, code examples, and references to the primary literature.

AI.tldr: 这是一本关于自主AI智能体系统构建的综合性实践参考书，涵盖从底层LLM基础（Transformer架构、训练优化、推理加速）到上层对齐与推理（RLHF、PPO/DPO/GRPO、思维链），再到智能体核心能力（RAG、记忆系统、工具使用、多智能体协作协议MCP/A2A），最后讨论开发框架、评估与生产部署。核心论点是：构建优秀智能体系统需要理解整个管道的每一层。
AI.motivation: 现有文献往往孤立地讨论LLM或智能体的某个层面，缺乏从底层到顶层的系统性指南。作者认为构建可靠的自主AI系统需要跨层理解，而非仅关注单一环节，因此撰写了这本覆盖全栈的实践参考书。
AI.method: 全书采用分层递进结构：第一层介绍LLM基座（Transformer、GPU系统、训练与微调方法SFT/LoRA/MoE、模型压缩、推理优化）；第二层讨论对齐与推理（RLHF、PPO/DPO/GRPO、奖励建模、大推理模型的RL与思维链、测试时扩展）；第三层聚焦智能体核心（基于轨迹的RL训练、RAG与Agentic RAG、多种记忆系统、智能体框架设计、设计模式分类学）；第四层处理智能体间协调（MCP协议、工具使用、A2A通信协议、集中/去中心/分层多智能体拓扑）；最后涵盖开发框架、UI设计、评估方法与生产部署。每章均结合理论基础、实现指南、代码示例与文献引用。
AI.result: 该书提供了一套完整的自主AI智能体构建知识体系，从LLM底层原理到智能体顶层应用，系统化梳理了各层关键技术及其关联，并通过实践指南和代码示例降低了理论到落地的门槛。
AI.conclusion: 构建优秀的自主AI智能体系统必须跨越从LLM底层到智能体协调的全栈理解，不能仅关注单一层面。该书作为综合参考，为 practitioners 提供了系统化的知识框架和实践路径。

title: AeroCast: Probabilistic 3D Trajectory Prediction for Non-Cooperative Aerial Obstacles via Transformer-MDN Architecture
summary: Autonomous aerial vehicles operating in shared airspace must predict the future positions of non-cooperative obstacles to plan evasive maneuvers before a collision becomes unavoidable. Unlike cooperative systems that share intent, non-cooperative obstacles such as birds, uncontrolled drones, or debris exhibit multi-modal motion that deterministic predictors cannot adequately represent. Existing methods either rely on recurrent encoders that propagate temporal information sequentially, limiting their ability to capture long-range kinematic precursors of maneuver initiation, or produce point forecasts that provide no distributional information to downstream planners. This paper presents AeroCast, a probabilistic trajectory prediction framework that combines a Transformer encoder with a Mixture Density Network output head to predict per-timestep Gaussian mixture distributions over future three-dimensional displacements. A translation-invariant consecutive displacement encoding and a calibration-oriented training objective address the input design and mode-degeneracy challenges specific to mixture-based aerial trajectory prediction. On a hybrid real-and-synthetic quadrotor corpus spanning nine motion categories, AeroCast reduces Average Displacement Error and Final Displacement Error by approximately 50% relative to the baselines over a five-second horizon, and achieves the lowest negative log-likelihood and Continuous Ranked Probability Score among all compared methods. Ablation analysis identifies velocity input and model capacity as the primary contributors to prediction quality, and positional encoding as essential for long-horizon trajectory coherence. AeroCast inference completes in 0.1ms per sample, compatible with real-time onboard deployment at 100Hz.

AI.tldr: AeroCast提出了一种结合Transformer编码器与混合密度网络的概率性轨迹预测框架，用于预测非合作空中障碍物的未来位置，在五秒预测时域上相比基线方法减少约50%的位移误差，推理仅需0.1ms，适合实时部署。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么使用循环编码器难以捕捉长程运动前兆，要么仅产生点预测无法提供分布信息给下游规划器，无法充分处理非合作障碍物的多模态运动模式。
AI.method: 采用Transformer编码器捕捉长程运动依赖，结合混合密度网络输出每时间步的高斯混合分布；提出平移不变连续位移编码和校准导向的训练目标，解决输入设计和模式退化问题。
AI.result: 在包含九种运动类别的混合数据集上，五秒时域内ADE和FDE均降低约50%；NLL和CRPS均最优；消融实验表明速度输入和模型容量是关键，位置编码对长时域轨迹一致性重要；推理时间0.1ms，支持100Hz实时部署。
AI.conclusion: AeroCast在精度、概率预测质量和实时性上均显著优于现有方法，为无人机在共享空域中的自主避险提供了有效的概率轨迹预测方案。

title: Curvature-Guided Mixing for MLLM Adaptation
summary: Fine-tuning Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on specialized tasks often leads to catastrophic forgetting of their general capabilities. Existing model merging methods to combat this are often heuristic or use sub-optimal objectives. We propose CurvatureGuided Mixing (CGM), a theoretically grounded framework that merges pre-trained and fine-tuned models. CGM formulates a joint optimization objective and uses a second-order (Hessian) approximation of the loss landscapes to analytically derive an optimal, closed-form "soft mixing" ratio. This ratio intelligently blends parameters based on their relative task-specific curvatures. We also introduce CGM$\dagger$, a robust "hard mixing" variant that performs sparse parameter selection guided by a novel, curvature-aware score. Experiments on LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5VL across multiple downstream tasks show that CGM and CGM$\dagger$ consistently improve the trade-off between task specialization and general knowledge retention over existing methods. Code is available at github.com/zzsyjl/CGM-ECCV-2026.

AI.tldr: 提出CurvatureGuided Mixing (CGM)框架，通过Hessian矩阵近似损失景观，推导出最优软混合比，并引入硬混合变体CGM†，有效缓解MLLM微调中的灾难性遗忘问题，在LLaVA-1.5和Qwen2.5VL上取得更好效果。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在专用任务微调后会出现灾难性遗忘，现有模型合并方法多为启发式或使用次优目标函数。
AI.method: 提出CGM框架：1) 构建联合优化目标；2) 利用二阶(Hessian)近似损失景观，解析推导出封闭形式的"软混合"比例；3) 引入CGM†变体，基于曲率感知的评分进行稀疏参数选择（硬混合）。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5和Qwen2.5VL多个下游任务上，CGM和CGM†持续改进了任务专业化与通用知识保持之间的权衡，优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于曲率引导的模型混合方法在理论上更严谨，实践上更有效，能更好地平衡微调后的专用能力与预训练的通用能力。

title: Project Auto-World: Towards Automated Benchmarking of Neural Relational Reasoners
comment: Submitted to NeurIPS 2026 E&D track. Code is available at https://github.com/autoworldrules/auto-world-rules
summary: Reasoning about relational structures remains a significant challenge for neural models, particularly when they must systematically apply learned knowledge to problem instances that are harder than those seen in training. Progress is hampered by the difficulty of evaluating such generalization, since a priori, it is rarely clear what makes an instance hard. We study how this issue can be addressed by using large language models (LLMs) to automate benchmark generation, learning to produce increasingly challenging instances in an end-to-end manner. Concretely, given a world parametrized by Datalog rules, and an Edge Transformer as the reasoning evaluator, we use LLM-driven evolutionary search (based on FunSearch) and autonomous agentic search to discover sampling functions that yield hard problem instances. We also show that the Edge Transformer can be improved using this data such that it generalizes well to further data perturbations. Finally, we show that the same machinery can be applied to novel worlds proposed by LLMs, opening the door to autonomous research on neural relational reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大语言模型（LLM）自动生成更难的推理基准测试实例，通过进化搜索和自主代理搜索，提升神经模型在关系结构推理上的泛化能力，并展示了该机制可扩展到LLM提出的新世界。
AI.motivation: 神经模型在关系结构推理上的泛化能力评估困难，因为很难预先判断什么使得一个实例变难。现有基准测试难以有效衡量模型的系统性泛化能力。
AI.method: 以Datalog规则参数化的世界和Edge Transformer作为推理评估器，采用基于LLM的进化搜索（FunSearch）和自主代理搜索来发现能生成困难实例的采样函数。
AI.result: Edge Transformer可以利用生成的困难数据得到改进，并很好地泛化到进一步的数据扰动上。该机制还可应用于LLM提出的新世界。
AI.conclusion: LLM自动化基准生成可以有效推动神经关系推理的评估与发展，为自主研究神经关系推理开辟新路径。

title: RGB: RL Guided Whole-Body MPPI for Humanoid Control
summary: Humanoid robots require whole-body controllers that are both robust and precise in contact-rich environments. While deep reinforcement learning (RL) achieves robust stability, its behavior is tightly coupled to the training objective and command interface, making it difficult to add new feedback objectives without retraining. In this study, we propose an RL guided whole-body model predictive path integral (MPPI) framework that acts as an add-on feedback controller on top of a pretrained RL policy. Instead of using RL policy as the final controller, we use it as a sampling prior that biases MPPI rollouts toward dynamically feasible behaviors. Task objectives are specified through modular MPPI cost terms, and MPPI closes the loop by continuously correcting the RL prior online to satisfy these objectives without retraining the policy. Simulations on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 humanoid in MuJoCo demonstrate stable high-rate control (average 280~Hz). The proposed method improves task-level precision over a pure RL baseline under the same command interface. This is achieved by correcting systematic drift during straight walking and tracking additional whole-body reference signals imposed through the cost.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种RL引导的全身MPPI框架，作为预训练RL策略的附加反馈控制器，通过模块化成本项实现任务目标，无需重新训练即可提高精度和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 深度RL虽能实现鲁棒稳定性，但其行为与训练目标强耦合，难以在不重新训练的情况下添加新的反馈目标。
AI.method: 使用RL策略作为MPPI的采样先验，通过MPPI成本项指定任务目标，在线修正RL先验以满足目标。
AI.result: 在29-DOF Unitree G1人形机器人上的仿真表明，该方法实现了稳定高速控制（平均280 Hz），并在任务精度上优于纯RL基线。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过纠正系统漂移和跟踪额外的全身参考信号，在不重新训练的情况下提升了任务级精度。

title: Noise-Aware Boundary-Enhanced Generative Learning for Ultrasound Speckle Reduction
summary: Ultrasound is a non-invasive, real-time, and cost-effective imaging technique widely used in clinical diagnosis. However, its diagnostic efficacy is often compromised by inherent speckle noise that degrades image quality and obscures underlying anatomical structures. Existing speckle reduction methods tend to over-smooth tissue boundaries and generalize poorly to heterogeneous noise levels. To address these limitations, we propose a Noise-Aware Boundary-Enhanced Generative Learning (NBGL) framework for ultrasound speckle reduction, which simultaneously preserves annotated anatomical boundaries and adapts to varying noise levels. The NBGL framework consists of a speckle reduction branch and a boundary enhancement branch. The former leverages generative learning to suppress speckle noise, while the latter learns boundary-sensitive representations to preserve target anatomical structures. Furthermore, a noise-aware interaction weight generation (NIWG) module estimates the speckle noise level via 3D Laplacian filtering and a median absolute deviation estimator, and translates it into an adaptive interaction weight. This weight is incorporated into a weighted feature-wise linear modulation (wFiLM) module to adaptively modulate cross-branch feature coupling, thereby improving robustness to varying noise levels. Extensive evaluations on 141 3D transvaginal ultrasound volumes demonstrate that NBGL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in speckle reduction and structural preservation across six noise levels, while maintaining consistency with annotated anatomical boundaries.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种噪声感知边界增强生成学习框架（NBGL），通过生成学习抑制散斑噪声、边界分支保留解剖结构，并利用自适应噪声权重模块实现跨噪声水平的鲁棒性，在141个3D经阴道超声数据上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 超声图像中的散斑噪声严重影响诊断质量，现有降噪方法存在过度平滑组织边界、对不同噪声水平泛化能力差的问题。
AI.method: 提出NBGL框架，包含散斑抑制分支（生成学习）和边界增强分支（边界敏感表征学习）；设计NIWG模块通过3D拉普拉斯滤波和中位绝对偏差估计噪声水平，生成自适应交互权重；采用加权特征线性调制（wFiLM）模块实现跨分支自适应特征耦合调节。
AI.result: 在141个3D经阴道超声数据上，NBGL在6种噪声水平下在散斑抑制和解剖结构保持方面一致优于现有方法，且与标注的解剖边界保持一致性。
AI.conclusion: NBGL框架能有效解决超声散斑噪声问题，在保持解剖边界的同时适应不同噪声水平，具有临床应用潜力。

title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Compounding Failures in Agentic Persuasion via Taxonomic Strategy Retrieval
summary:
Foundation-model agents in multi-step, open-ended environments frequently suffer from compounding errors, where early mistakes contaminate long-horizon trajectories. While Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) succeeds in deterministic domains, agents in subjective tasks like persuasion experience severe problem drift and sycophantic conformity. We identify semantic leakage in standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) as a reproducible trigger for these failures, as standard RAG prioritizes vocabulary overlap over logical necessity.
  To eliminate this leakage, we introduce Taxonomic Strategy RAG (TS-RAG), a systems intervention that routes strategies through a discrete categorical bottleneck to decouple argumentative structure from topical content. Zero-shot, cross-domain evaluations demonstrate that TS-RAG significantly improves the transfer of abstract logic where standard semantic retrieval collapses. Crucially, TS-RAG acts as a "capability bridge" in asymmetric deployments, empowering lightweight persuaders to consistently defeat parametrically superior opponents (improving win rates from 70.5 to 78.5) and accelerating argumentative efficiency. Finally, we introduce trace-level diagnostics via a turn-by-turn Debate State Representation (DSR), demonstrating the necessity of strict constraints to prevent evaluation collapse via default agentic sycophancy.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多步开放式环境中基础模型代理的复合错误问题，提出TS-RAG方法，通过离散分类瓶颈消除语义泄漏，显著提升轻量级代理在说服任务中的胜率（70.5%→78.5%），并引入辩论状态表征（DSR）诊断机制。
AI.motivation: 现有MAD在主观性任务（如说服）中存在问题漂移和谄媚性从众，标准RAG因优先词汇重叠而非逻辑必要性导致语义泄漏，成为这些失败的诱因。
AI.method: 提出Taxonomic Strategy RAG（TS-RAG），通过离散分类瓶颈路由策略，将论证结构与主题内容解耦；同时引入辩论状态表征（DSR）进行逐回合诊断。
AI.result: 零样本跨域评估显示TS-RAG显著改善抽象逻辑迁移能力；在非对称部署中，轻量级说服者胜率从70.5%提升至78.5%，论证效率提升。
AI.conclusion: 严格约束（如TS-RAG）对防止评估崩溃和默认代理谄媚行为至关重要，TS-RAG可作为能力桥梁弥合参数不对称代理之间的性能差距。

title: Causality-Based Parametric Control Barrier Function for Safe Multi-Vehicle Interaction
summary: Safe control has been widely studied in various safety-critical applications, for instance, autonomous driving. In order to ensure the autonomous vehicle does not collide with other vehicles, it is essential to obtain an accurate expectation of surrounding vehicles' behavior and react adaptively. Instead of assuming fully cooperative and homogeneous vehicles using the same safety-critical controllers, recent works have been exploring different data-driven approaches to model the neighboring vehicles' underlying controllers with observed data. However, existing works either suffer from 1) the inter-vehicle influence during the multi-vehicle interaction, which makes it hard to determine the causality of surrounding vehicles' behavior in controller modeling, or 2) being dominated by the worst-case analysis, which may lead to overly conservative behavior. In this paper, we extend the prior work on Parametric-Control Barrier Function (Parametric-CBF) to multi-robot interactions with embedded causality inference to explicitly reason over the inter-vehicle influence. Given the learned Causality-based Parametric-CBF, we present an adaptive safety-critical controller that allows the ego vehicle to safely react to surrounding vehicles with the learned expectation. We demonstrate that by leveraging the motion flexibility among multi-vehicle systems, task efficiency can be greatly improved in various interaction-intensive scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于因果推理的参数化控制屏障函数（Parametric-CBF）方法，用于多车辆交互场景下的安全控制。该方法通过嵌入因果推理来明确推理车辆间的相互影响，从而使自车能够自适应地反应于周围车辆行为，在保证安全的同时提升任务效率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理多车辆交互时存在两个问题：1) 难以确定周围车辆行为的因果关系（受车辆间相互影响干扰）；2) 过度依赖最坏情况分析，导致控制策略过于保守。因此需要一种能够明确建模车辆间因果影响的安全控制器。
AI.method: 将Parametric-Control Barrier Function（Parametric-CBF）扩展到多机器人交互场景，并在其中嵌入因果推理（causality inference），形成Causality-based Parametric-CBF。基于该函数设计自适应安全控制器，使自车能够根据对周围车辆行为的学习期望做出安全响应。
AI.result: 在多种交互密集型场景中，通过利用多车辆系统的运动灵活性，所提方法显著提升了任务效率。实验表明，该方法能够有效缓解传统方法过于保守的问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过因果推理与参数化CBF的结合，可以在多车辆交互中实现更高效且非保守的安全控制，为自动驾驶等安全关键应用提供了新的思路。

title: Yuvion VL: A Multimodal Foundation Model for Adversarial Content and AI Safety
summary: General-purpose models often struggle to reliably identify and understand real-world multimodal risks, largely due to the inherent multimodal adversarial nature of content and AI safety. We present Yuvion VL, a family of multimodal large language models purpose-built for content and AI safety, with both instruction-tuned and reasoning-oriented variants. Yuvion VL addresses this gap by treating safety as an inherently adversarial and multimodal problem and designing the entire pipeline around adversarial robustness. For data construction, we develop an automated pipeline integrating adversarial-aware data synthesis with multi-stage quality control, producing large-scale, high-quality multimodal samples augmented with domain knowledge and reasoning annotations. For training, we adopt a three-stage pipeline that includes continued pretraining for risk-concept cross-modal alignment, instruct post-training for production-grade safety tasks, and reasoning post-training for enhanced interpretability and performance in complex tasks. We further introduce Confuse-then-Contrast Fine-Tuning, a contrastive framework that mines model-specific confusions and constructs multi-image contrastive groups to enforce explicit discrimination of fine-grained visual-semantic elements, enabling the model to distinguish between visually similar cases with different safety implications in adversarial safety tasks. To support rigorous evaluation, we further introduce Yuvion VL RiskEval (YVRE), a collection of benchmarks covering diverse open and internal evaluations, with a focus on content and AI safety, adversarial robustness, and real-world capability requirements. Experiments show that Yuvion VL-32B achieves industry-leading safety performance, surpassing comparably sized open-source models and best closed-source commercial models, while maintaining comparable general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Yuvion VL，一个专为内容与AI安全设计的多模态大语言模型系列，通过将安全视为对抗性多模态问题，构建自动化数据合成管道、三阶段训练流程以及Confuse-then-Contrast Fine-Tuning框架，在安全性上超越同等规模开源模型和顶级闭源商业模型。
AI.motivation: 通用模型难以可靠识别和理解真实世界的多模态风险，主要是因为内容和AI安全具有内在的多模态对抗性，现有方法缺乏对此问题的专门设计。
AI.method: 1）自动化对抗感知数据合成管道，融合领域知识与推理标注；2）三阶段训练：持续预训练（跨模态风险概念对齐）、指令微调（生产级安全任务）、推理微调（可解释性）；3）Confuse-then-Contrast Fine-Tuning（C3FT）对比学习框架，挖掘模型特定混淆点并构建多图像对比组，强制区分视觉上相似但安全含义不同的样本。
AI.result: Yuvion VL-32B在安全性能上达到行业领先水平，超越同等规模开源模型和顶级闭源商业模型，同时保持相当的一般能力。
AI.conclusion: 将安全作为固有对抗性多模态问题来设计整个管道是实现高效多模态安全模型的关键路径。

title: Do vision-language models search like humans? Reasoning tokens as a reaction-time analog in classic visual-search paradigms
summary: Visual search has been one of the most productive paradigms in the study of visual attention: the way reaction time scales with the number of items distinguishes parallel, "pop-out" search from serial, attention-demanding search. I ask whether vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit the same behavioral signatures. I adapt four classic paradigms: feature versus conjunction search, spatial-configuration (T-vs-L) search, enumeration, and the tilted/vertical search asymmetry; and present them to current frontier and mid-tier models. Because a single model call has no reaction time, I use the number of reasoning ("thinking") tokens a model spends per trial as a within-model analog of search effort, and I compare against a large public human benchmark (Wolfe et al., 2010). The models reproduce several human signatures: feature search costs flat effort while conjunction effort climbs with set size; frontier models hold accuracy where mid-tier models collapse to chance; and a resolution control shows the conjunction cost is genuine search rather than difficulty resolving small shapes. They also diverge from humans in informative ways. The target-present effort slope exceeds the target-absent slope, reversing the human ordering; enumeration remains accurate where humans would lose count; and a reasoning model with adaptive deliberation declines to deliberate on detection tasks altogether, so that a single search expresses itself as an effort gradient in one model and as an accuracy cliff in another. I argue that psychophysical paradigms, applied behaviorally, are a sharp and inexpensive probe of machine visual cognition, and that the points of divergence are as informative as the points of agreement.

AI.tldr: 本文通过改编四项经典视觉搜索范式，测试视觉语言模型（VLM）的行为是否与人类相似。研究发现VLM在某些方面复现了人类特征（如特征搜索成本恒定、合取搜索成本随数量增加），但也在关键点上与人类存在差异（如目标存在斜率高于目标不存在斜率、枚举计数超过人类能力），作者认为心理物理学范式是探测机器视觉认知的有效工具。
AI.motivation: 探究视觉语言模型（VLM）是否具备与人类相似的视觉注意行为特征，特别是经典的并行/序列搜索区分模式，从而揭示机器视觉认知与人类视觉认知的异同。
AI.method: 改编四项经典视觉搜索范式（特征vs合取搜索、T-vs-L空间构型搜索、枚举、倾斜/垂直搜索不对称性），在多个VLM上进行测试。用模型每轮推理产生的"思考token"数量作为搜索努力的代理指标，并与大规模人类公开基准数据对比。
AI.result: 模型复现了人类的部分特征：特征搜索成本恒定、合取搜索成本随数量增加；前沿模型保持高准确率而中端模型降至随机水平；分辨率控制实验表明合取成本源于真实搜索而非分辨率限制。存在差异：目标存在斜率超过目标不存在斜率（与人类相反）；枚举准确率高到人类无法达到；推理模型在检测任务上拒绝进行自适应推理。
AI.conclusion: 心理物理学范式作为行为层面的探测工具，是评估机器视觉认知的经济且有效的手段。模型与人类的一致点和分歧点同样具有信息价值，揭示了机器与人类视觉认知的根本差异。

title: Memory Retrieval in Visuomotor Policies for Long-Horizon Robot Control
summary: General-purpose robots operating in partially observable environments, such as homes, require memory to support autonomy. They must recall diverse information from the past, such as where objects were placed, which tasks a human partner has completed, and when an appliance was turned on. Achieving this versatility requires a general memory retrieval mechanism. Transformer architectures that use attention over long contexts for memory retrieval provide a promising approach, as they learn retrieval from data rather than relying on task-specific or hand-designed rules. However, directly incorporating them into imitation learning from offline data introduces two key challenges: (1) the policy may learn spurious correlations between past information and predicted actions, and (2) errors accumulate in memory due to prediction inaccuracies and their compounding interactions with the environment, causing model drift and cascading failures. To address both challenges, we introduce HALO, a visuomotor policy with an attention-based memory retrieval mechanism for long-horizon control. First, to suppress spurious correlations, HALO distills vision-language model (VLM) priors into the policy. It generates memory-dependent question--answer pairs from demonstration trajectories and trains jointly with a video question--answering objective, steering retrieval toward task-relevant information. Second, to reduce the impact of accumulated errors in memory during closed-loop control, HALO uses sparse attention that restricts retrieval to only the most relevant parts of the history. Together, these components enable more reliable long-horizon control by guiding the policy to retrieve task-relevant information from up to eight minutes of past experience. Project website: https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/HALO

AI.tldr: HALO是一种结合视觉语言模型先验和稀疏注意力机制的视觉运动策略，通过关注记忆检索实现机器人在部分可观测环境中的长时程自主控制，能够从长达8分钟的历史经验中检索任务相关信息。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人在部分可观测环境（如家庭）中需要记忆支持自主性，但现有Transformer记忆检索机制在模仿学习中存在两个问题：策略学到虚假相关性（过去信息与预测动作之间的虚假关联）；记忆误差累积导致模型漂移和级联失败。
AI.method: HALO通过两个关键设计解决上述挑战：(1) 蒸馏视觉语言模型先验，从示范轨迹生成记忆相关问答对，联合视频问答目标训练，引导检索到任务相关信息；(2) 采用稀疏注意力机制，限制检索只关注历史中最相关的部分，减少闭环控制中记忆误差累积的影响。
AI.result: HALO能够从长达8分钟的历史经验中检索任务相关信息，实现更可靠的长时程控制。
AI.conclusion: HALO通过结合VLM先验蒸馏和稀疏注意力机制，有效解决了Transformer记忆检索在机器人模仿学习中的虚假相关性和误差累积问题，为通用机器人在部分可观测环境中的长时程自主控制提供了可行方案。

title: Chorus II: Cross-Request Sparsity Reuse for Efficient Image-to-Video Generation
summary: Serving diffusion models for image-to-video generation is computationally expensive, posing significant challenges for large-scale deployment. Real I2V workloads often contain similar requests, such as repeated effect templates, related subjects, and recurring shot layouts. Existing cross-request acceleration methods mainly exploit this redundancy through feature reuse. We observe that similar I2V requests also share highly consistent sparse attention patterns, enabling historical sparse masks to serve as request-conditioned priors with almost no online mask-prediction overhead. We propose a cross-request reuse framework centered on \textbf{sparsity reuse}, with \textbf{feature reuse} as an optional extension safeguarded by a lightweight \textbf{guidance enhancement}. Our sparsity reuse is implemented as shared sparse mask reuse, which reuses high-quality sparse masks from similar historical requests to avoid per-request online mask prediction. Optional feature reuse applies downsampled computation to highly redundant spatiotemporal regions, mitigating boundary artifacts while preserving efficiency gains. Guidance enhancement reinforces image/text conditioning after reuse, mitigating semantic drift and condition-adherence issues. Experiments show that default sparsity reuse configuration preserves generation quality with a \textbf{2.16$\times$} speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向图像到视频（I2V）生成扩散模型的跨请求复用框架，通过稀疏性复用（共享稀疏掩码）为主、特征复用为辅的方式，在几乎不影响生成质量的情况下实现2.16倍加速。
AI.motivation: I2V扩散模型推理计算成本高，难以大规模部署；实际工作负载中存在大量相似请求（如重复效果模板、相关主体、镜头布局），现有跨请求加速方法主要利用特征复用，但忽略了稀疏注意力模式的复用潜力。
AI.method: 提出以稀疏性复用为核心的跨请求复用框架：1）稀疏掩码复用——从历史相似请求中复用高质量稀疏掩码，避免新增在线掩码预测开销；2）可选的特征复用——对高冗余时空区域进行降采样计算，减少边界伪影；3）轻量级引导增强——复用后强化图像/文本条件，缓解语义漂移和条件偏差。
AI.result: 默认稀疏性复用配置在保持生成质量的前提下，实现了2.16倍加速。特征复用作为可选扩展，进一步在高效与质量之间取得平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了稀疏性复用在I2V扩散模型加速中的有效性，为大规模部署提供了一种低成本、高质量的跨请求复用方案。

title: Beyond Shapley: Efficient Computation of Asymmetric Shapley Values
summary: We address the problem of explainability in machine learning models through feature attribution methods. In particular, we consider a variant of Shapley values known as Asymmetric Shapley Values (ASV), which enables the incorporation of causal knowledge into model-agnostic explanations through the use of a causal graph. We show that in certain contexts in which the computation of SHAP is $\#P$-hard, the exact computation of ASV can be done in polynomial time. To extend this algorithmic result, we introduce a notion of equivalence classes over the topological orderings of the underlying causal graph, which is useful to reduce the time to compute ASV. In particular, we present a polynomial-time algorithm (in the number of equivalence classes) to compute it whenever the causal graph is a rooted directed tree. Finally, we develop an algorithm for approximating ASV in arbitrary causal DAGs which relies on a procedure to sample topological orderings uniformly at random. To implement this sampling mechanism we leverage known algorithms as well as simpler alternatives. Our experimental results demonstrate the practical viability of the proposed approach in realistic causal structures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非对称Shapley值（ASV）在因果图下的高效计算，提出多项式时间算法（针对有根树结构）及针对任意因果DAG的近似采样算法，实验验证了实用性。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型的可解释性需求，现有SHAP值在某些上下文中计算复杂度过高（#P-hard），而ASV通过引入因果知识可降低计算复杂度，但精确计算仍存在挑战。
AI.method: 1) 证明ASV在特定上下文中可在多项式时间内精确计算；2) 引入拓扑序等价类概念加速计算；3) 针对有根树提出多项式时间算法；4) 针对任意因果DAG设计基于均匀拓扑序采样的近似算法。
AI.result: ASV在特定条件下多项式时间可解；等价类方法有效降低计算量；近似算法在现实因果结构中表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 提出的ASV计算与近似方法在理论上降低了复杂度，在实践上具有可行性与有效性，为因果感知的可解释性提供了高效工具。

title: SwarmFly: A simulation platform for UAV swarm experiment design and validation
summary: The initial development phase of UAV swarms largely depends on simulation for experimental design and validation, yet existing open-source tools are often unmaintained, have steep learning curves, or are built around a single fixed scenario. The need for a comprehensive, modular simulation platform is a recognized research gap. This paper presents SwarmFly, a MATLAB-based simulation and test platform for multi- UAV swarms that addresses these gaps. SwarmFly combines a real-time operational map, four swarm coordination modes (leader-follower, decentralized, heterogeneous relay, and heterogeneous speed), simulated IMU telemetry, and IP-based geolocation with a plugin architecture that lets researchers add behaviors, fault models, and analysis tools without touching the core code. Eight bundled plugins extend the base simulator into a full test harness. The SwarmFly platform exposes multi-agent aerial swarms to a wide range of internal and external disruptions, enabling observation and quantification of underlying swarm control and behavioral mechanisms. This study verifies and characterizes each subsystem through eight experiments that measure formation accuracy, wind tolerance, fault recovery, energy endurance, and airspace compliance. The platform runs entirely in MATLAB. Its modular design supports straightforward extension toward hardware-in-the-loop testing, larger swarms, and higher-fidelity dynamics. An open-source release is available at [https://github.com/abhishekphadke/SwarmFly.git]

AI.tldr: 本文提出SwarmFly，一个基于MATLAB的模块化多无人机蜂群仿真与测试平台，解决了现有开源工具维护不足、学习曲线陡峭、场景单一等问题，并通过八项实验验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有开源无人机蜂群仿真工具存在维护不善、学习门槛高、仅支持单一场景等问题，亟需一个全面、模块化的仿真平台来填补研究空白。
AI.method: SwarmFly采用MATLAB开发，集成实时运行地图、四种蜂群协调模式（领航-跟随、去中心化、异构中继、异构速度）、模拟IMU遥测、基于IP的地理定位，并设计了插件架构，允许研究人员在不修改核心代码的前提下扩展行为、故障模型和分析工具。
AI.result: 通过八项实验验证了编队精度、抗风能力、故障恢复、能量续航和空域合规性等子系统性能。平台完全运行于MATLAB，已开源发布。
AI.conclusion: SwarmFly的模块化设计支持便捷扩展到硬件在环测试、更大规模蜂群和更高保真度动力学仿真，为无人机蜂群研究提供了灵活、可扩展的仿真基础。

title: Wan-Streamer v0.1: End-to-end Real-time Interactive Foundation Models
summary: We present Wan-Streamer, a native-streaming, end-to-end interactive foundation model designed from the ground up for real-time, low-latency, full-duplex audio-visual interaction. Wan-Streamer seamlessly models language, audio, and video as both input and output within a single Transformer, where the sequence is represented as interleaved visual, audio, and text input tokens together with visual, audio, and text output tokens, coordinated by block-causal attention for incremental streaming. Unlike cascaded interactive systems that rely on separate VAD, ASR, language, TTS, audio-driven animation, or video-generation modules, Wan-Streamer does not rely on external language, speech, avatar, or video-generation modules: perception, reasoning, generation, response timing, turn management, and cross-modal synchronization are learned jointly within one unified model, reducing pipeline latency and error accumulation. To support natural audio-visual responsiveness, we redesign the entire stack around streamability, including causal encoders, causal decoders, block-causal attention, and low-latency multimodal token scheduling, enabling streaming units as short as 160 ms at 25 fps. Wan-Streamer achieves approximately 200 ms model-side response latency and approximately 550 ms total interaction latency when combined with 350 ms bidirectional network latency, supporting sub-second duplex audio-visual communication. These results position Wan-Streamer as a unified, end-to-end, multimodal interactive foundation model for low-latency streaming interaction.

AI.tldr: Wan-Streamer 是一个原生流式、端到端交互基础模型，基于单一Transformer统一建模语言、音频和视频的输入输出，采用块因果注意力支持增量流式处理，实现约200ms模型响应延迟和约550ms总交互延迟，支持亚秒级全双工视听交互。
AI.motivation: 现有级联交互系统依赖独立的VAD、ASR、语言、TTS、语音驱动动画或视频生成模块，导致流水线延迟和错误累积。作者希望设计一个统一模型，将感知、推理、生成、响应时序、话轮管理和跨模态同步端到端联合学习，消除对多个外部模块的依赖。
AI.method: 设计了一个原生流式Transformer架构，将视觉、音频和文本输入/输出令牌交错排列，通过块因果注意力实现增量流式处理。重新设计了因果编码器、因果解码器、块因果注意力和低延迟多模态令牌调度，支持25fps下160ms的流式单元粒度。所有模态的感知、推理和生成在一个统一模型中联合学习。
AI.result: 模型侧响应延迟约200ms，结合350ms双向网络延迟后总交互延迟约550ms，实现了亚秒级全双工视听通信。
AI.conclusion: Wan-Streamer 证明了统一、端到端、多模态交互基础模型在低延迟流式交互中的可行性，为实时视听交互提供了新的范式。

title: The Clinician's Veto: Navigating Trust, Liability, and Uncertainty in Autonomous AI Prescribing
summary: Autonomous AI systems are transitioning from advisory to autonomous roles for medication prescriptions. Recent United States bill H.R. 238 and Utah's prescription-renewal pilot both authorize AI to prescribe medications in an agentic capacity. While some regulatory guidelines suggest aggregate model performance metrics for clearance, they do not require i) calibrated per-prediction confidence for action-gated thresholds, ii) differentiated communication of uncertainty arising from model ignorance (epistemic) versus genuine clinical ambiguity (aleatoric), and iii) inferential transparency at the moment of decision that allows for liability allocation. Here, we present a regulatory and technical argument (tested with a survey of 136 U.S. prescribing clinicians) positioning these as minimum architectural requirements for safe autonomous prescribing. Our results suggest prescribing clinicians i) would not permit autonomous prescribing without a calibrated confidence-based escalation mechanism, ii) preferred a competing-options summary when uncertainty was aleatoric but shifted to abstention when uncertainty was epistemic, and iii) were only willing to accept additional liability when inferential transparency enabled a substantive judgment under acknowledged uncertainty. These findings indicate our recommended architectural features would encourage higher rates of clinician adoption, largely through collapsing much of what "autonomy" conventionally means. A system meeting these requirements would function less as an autonomous agent and more as a heavily supervised decision-support tool. As legislation and state pilots proceed, our technical argument backed by clinician perspectives provides opportunities for regulation to constrain the degree of autonomy ethically granted to AI in prescribing while aligning liability with the institutional actors who control system design and deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI自主开药系统应具备三个最低架构要求：校准的置信度阈值、区分认知与偶然不确定性、决策时的推理透明度。通过对136名美国临床医生调查，发现这些特征能提高医生采纳率，同时将AI从"自主代理"转变为"高度监督的决策辅助工具"。
AI.motivation: 现有AI开药监管仅要求聚合性能指标，缺乏对逐次预测的校准置信度、不确定性来源区分（模型无知 vs. 临床模糊性）以及决策时刻的推理透明度的要求，导致安全隐患和责任归属不清。
AI.method: 1) 提出监管与技术论证框架；2) 对136名美国开药临床医生进行调查研究，评估医生对三种架构要求的态度。
AI.result: 医生们：①不允许在没有校准置信度升级机制的情况下让AI自主开药；②在偶然不确定性下偏好竞争性选项摘要，在认知不确定性下偏好弃权；③仅在推理透明度允许其在承认不确定性下做出实质判断时，才愿承担额外责任。
AI.conclusion: 这些架构特征会降低AI的"自主性"，使其更像是高度监督的决策辅助工具。监管应利用这些技术要求来约束AI在开药中的伦理自主程度，并将责任与控制系统设计和部署的机构行为者对齐。

title: Toward Low-Latency Vision-Language Models with Doubly-Correct Predictions in Egocentric Visual Understanding
comment: International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026
summary: The rapid rise of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in egocentric visual understanding has made low-latency inference in human-robot collaborative (HRC) tasks increasingly critical. Weight pruning techniques developed for VLMs to shrink model size and computation can be readily applied to satisfy the efficiency demands of on-board processing and real-time interactive robotics. Moreover, safe human-robot interaction demands pruning strategies that preserve doubly-correct predictions; outputs must be both accurate and evidentially grounded to mitigate risks and ensure user trust. In this paper, we present a new study of VLM pruning through the lens of doubly-correct prediction. Our experiments surprisingly show that existing pruning methods often preserve the right evidence localization but undermine correct prediction. To address this, we propose a rationale-informed pruning strategy that better aligns evidence with decisions. Benchmark results on egocentric video datasets demonstrate that our method not only achieves the highest prediction accuracy but also outperforms existing approaches in attaining doubly-correct predictions. We aim to stimulate research on efficient and reliable VLMs, ensuring accuracy-driven advances align with the transparency, auditability, and safety required for responsible human-robot interaction and embodied intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究VLM剪枝中的"双重正确预测"问题（准确性+证据正确性），发现现有剪枝方法常保留正确证据但破坏正确预测，进而提出一种基于解释信息的剪枝策略，在自我中心视频基准上实现了更高的预测准确率和双重正确率。
AI.motivation: 在人机协作任务中，VLM需要低延迟推理，剪枝是常用手段。但安全的人机交互要求模型不仅预测准确，还要有正确的证据支持（双重正确预测），现有剪枝方法在这方面的表现尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 提出一种理性引导（rationale-informed）的剪枝策略，在剪枝过程中更好地对齐证据与决策，从而保持双重正确预测。
AI.result: 在自我中心视频数据集上，该方法在预测准确率和双重正确率两方面均优于现有剪枝方法。
AI.conclusion: VLM剪枝应兼顾效率与可解释性、安全性，本文的工作为负责任的人机交互和具身智能提供了新的方向。

title: FreeStory: Training-Free Character Consistency for Free-Form Visual Storytelling
summary: Visual storytelling aims to generate image sequences that are both aligned with narrative prompts and consistent in character appearance across images. Recent training-free methods improve character consistency by reusing attention features, but rely on structured prompts where full character descriptions are repeated in every prompt. This assumption simplifies the task but deviates from natural storytelling, where characters are typically introduced once and later referred to using pronouns or type-based expressions. We propose \textbf{FreeStory}, a training-free framework that reformulates character consistency under free-form prompts as entity-grounded feature reuse. Our method associates reference mentions with their corresponding character descriptions and combines dynamic character masks, correspondence-aware feature matching, key-value injection, and query blending to preserve identity while retaining generation diversity. We also introduce \textbf{FreeStoryBench}, a benchmark for this setting that includes both single- and multi-character stories. Experiments show that FreeStory achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods on structured benchmarks and stronger overall consistency over baselines under free-form prompts.

AI.tldr: FreeStory提出了一种无需训练的框架，通过实体锚定的特征复用技术，解决自由形式提示下视觉故事生成中的角色一致性问题，并发布了FreeStoryBench基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有训练无关方法假设结构化提示（每句重复完整角色描述），但真实故事叙述中角色通常只介绍一次，后续用代词或类型表达指代。这种假设偏离实际应用，因此需要一种支持自由形式提示的角色一致性方法。
AI.method: 提出FreeStory框架，通过实体锚定的特征复用实现：1) 将指代表达关联到对应的角色描述；2) 结合动态角色掩码、对应感知特征匹配、键值注入和查询混合，在保持身份一致性的同时保留生成多样性。
AI.result: 在结构化提示基准上达到训练无关方法的最优性能，在自由形式提示下相比基线方法在整体一致性上更强。
AI.conclusion: FreeStory有效解决了自由形式提示下的角色一致性问题，无需额外训练即可在更自然的叙事场景中保持角色身份一致，同时维持生成多样性。

title: TRUSTMEM: Learning Trustworthy Memory Consolidation for LLM Agents with Long-Term Memory
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on long-term memory to support extended interactions and personalized assistance beyond finite context windows. Existing memory agents actively update external memory through generated write, revise, and delete operations, but these updates may omit important information, corrupt existing memory, or introduce unsupported hallucinated content. Once stored, such errors become persistent system-state failures that can affect future reasoning and generation. In this paper, we propose TrustMem, a framework designed to improve the trustworthiness of memory consolidation. TrustMem relies on a Memory Transition Verifier to evaluate the transition process of memory updates in terms of coverage, preservation, and faithfulness. It further constructs preference pairs among candidate updates under the same memory state, enabling preference-guided reinforcement learning to directly optimize memory updating behaviors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TrustMem improves both memory utility and reliability: it achieves state-of-the-art results across MemoryAgentBench, HaluMem, and the Mem-alpha validation set, improves HaluMem memory extraction by 12.14 F1 points, and reduces transition-level omission, corruption, and hallucination by 40.1\%, 79.1\%, and 50.0\%, respectively, compared with the strongest baseline for each error type.

AI.tldr: 提出TrustMem框架，通过记忆转换验证器和偏好引导强化学习，提升LLM智能体长期记忆更新的可信度，显著减少信息遗漏、记忆损坏和幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的外部记忆更新机制存在遗漏重要信息、损坏已有记忆、引入非事实内容等可靠性问题，这些错误会持续影响后续推理和生成。
AI.method: 提出TrustMem框架，核心是Memory Transition Verifier评估记忆更新的覆盖性、保留性和忠实性；并构建偏好对进行强化学习优化记忆更新行为。
AI.result: 在MemoryAgentBench、HaluMem和Mem-alpha验证集上取得SOTA结果；记忆提取F1提升12.14；遗漏、损坏、幻觉分别降低40.1%、79.1%、50.0%。
AI.conclusion: TrustMem能有效提升长期记忆更新的可信度和可靠性，为LLM智能体在外存管理方面提供了值得信赖的解决方案。

title: fARfetch: Enabling Collocated AR-HRC in Large Visually Diverse Environments with VLM-Driven AR Content Adaptation
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN). Author accepted manuscript
summary: Augmented Reality (AR) can improve collocated human-robot collaboration by making robot state and intent visible and enabling intuitive control, yet large, visually diverse environments like the outdoors challenge both interaction and content legibility, especially at long distances and beyond visual line of sight. We present fARfetch, an AR-HRC system that integrates (i) shared semantic environment mapping across an AR headset and robot that visualizes detected landmarks in AR to support landmark-grounded go-to commands, (ii) a context-aware world-in-miniature representation of the shared environment for fine-grained path authoring, and (iii) vision-language-model driven AR view management that jointly adapts virtual content color, size, and orientation to maintain legibility in large visually diverse environments. We implement fARfetch with a Meta Quest 3 headset and Unitree Go2 quadruped robot, and conduct a within-subjects user study (N=13) on a real-world large-scale (30.5m) outdoor inspection task. fARfetch yielded significantly faster completion times than a non-AR baseline (66%) and significantly lower workload in mental demand (-43%), temporal demand (-34%), and frustration (-66%). A custom legibility survey indicated fARfetch effectively maintained virtual content legibility in the large outdoor environment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出fARfetch，一个结合AR头显与机器人的增强现实人机协作系统，通过共享语义环境映射、情境感知世界缩微图和VLM驱动的AR视图管理，在大型室外环境中显著提升任务完成速度（66%）、降低工作负荷（43%心理需求、34%时间压力、66%挫败感）。
AI.motivation: 大型、视觉多样的室外环境（如户外）对AR交互和内容可读性构成挑战，尤其是在远距离和超出视线范围时，现有AR-HRC系统难以应对。
AI.method: (i) AR头显与机器人共享语义环境映射，可视化检测到的地标以支持地标锚定的go-to指令；(ii) 情境感知的世界缩微图用于精细路径编辑；(iii) 视觉-语言模型驱动的AR视图管理，联合调整虚拟内容的颜色、大小和方向以保持可读性。
AI.result: 在30.5米真实户外巡检任务中（N=13），fARfetch相比非AR基线提升66%完成速度，心理需求降低43%，时间压力降低34%，挫败感降低66%，可读性调查表明系统有效维持了虚拟内容在大型室外环境中的可读性。
AI.conclusion: fARfetch验证了结合共享语义映射、世界缩微图和VLM驱动视图管理可有效解决大型室外环境中的AR-HRC可读性与交互难题，显著提升协作效率和用户体验。

title: Are We There Yet? Exploring the Capabilities of MLLMs in Assistive AI Applications
summary:
Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have redefined visual understanding by combining vision encoders with large-scale language models. This unified architecture enables strong performance on tasks like image captioning, visual question answering, and multimodal dialogue, often in zero- and few-shot settings. Their general-purpose capabilities and flexible interfaces make MLLMs a promising foundation for real-world vision-language applications.
  Assistive AI aims to help users interact with their environments through natural language. These scenarios demand robust visual recognition, contextual reasoning, and multilingual comprehension-capabilities that MLLMs are believed to offer. However, their effectiveness in assistive settings remains to be fully understood.
  In this work, we explore whether MLLMs can support Assistive AI by evaluating state-of-the-art models on real-world tasks: recognizing everyday objects like currency, answering questions based on scene text, and reading visually presented content across multiple languages. To this end, we developed a system, NetraLink, using a head-mounted GoPro to capture real-world egocentric data, and collected a benchmark covering these assistive scenarios. Our findings provide a comprehensive diagnostic of current MLLMs, highlighting their strengths and limitations in enabling assistive technologies grounded in visual perception and language interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在辅助AI场景中的实际表现，通过构建基于头戴式GoPro的NetraLink系统收集真实世界数据，测试模型在货币识别、场景文本问答、多语言视觉内容读取等任务上的能力，揭示了当前MLLMs在辅助技术中的优势与局限。
AI.motivation: 尽管MLLMs在图像描述、视觉问答等通用任务上表现出色，但其在辅助AI（如帮助视障或语言障碍用户与环境交互）中的实际效果尚未被充分理解，因此需要系统评估。
AI.method: 开发NetraLink系统，使用头戴式GoPro采集真实世界自我中心数据，构建涵盖货币识别、场景文本问答、多语言视觉内容读取的基准测试集，对多个SOTA MLLMs进行评估。
AI.result: 提供了当前MLLMs在辅助AI场景中的全面诊断结果，明确了其能力优势与不足之处。
AI.conclusion: MLLMs具备辅助AI的潜力，但在真实场景的鲁棒性、多语言理解等方面仍有局限，需进一步改进才能可靠应用于辅助技术。

title: Elo-Disentangled Player-Style Embeddings for Human Chess via Rating-Conditioned Residual Move Model
summary: We study representation learning for individual human chess style: a per-player embedding learned from a player's move history such that inner products measure stylistic similarity, while being approximately disentangled from playing strength (Elo). Our key design is a residual formulation: a rating-conditioned base move model (Maia-3 policy logits plus Stockfish-derived features, scored over Maia-2-proposed candidates) captures what a typical player of a given strength would play, and a frozen copy of it anchors a learned move encoder and a per-player vector z, so that z explains only deviations from rating-typical play. The base model improves move prediction over the strong Maia-3 policy by 27-37% relative NLL across the rating spectrum, with the largest gains at the top (2800+); Stockfish's marginal value grows monotonically with Elo (negligible at 900-1200, +0.085 nats at 2800+). On a shared Elo-stratified benchmark of 22,620 held-out decisions, top-1 move-matching rises monotonically from Maia-2 to Maia-3 to the Stockfish-augmented base (0.51 -> 0.57 -> 0.68): the base is +33% relative top-1 over Maia-2 and +19% over Maia-3 (30% lower NLL), with the engine-feature lift largest at high Elo. The player embedding adds little to raw move-matching on top of this base -- its marginal top-1 gain falls within the 95% confidence interval -- and its value is instead representational: z generalizes to held-out decisions without overfitting, re-identifies players from disjoint games above chance, and a linear probe recovers rating from z with only R^2 = 0.06 (no better nonlinearly), evidence it captures style on an Elo-orthogonal axis. We argue that a strong rating-conditioned base plus a compact, Elo-disentangled embedding -- separating typical play from individual deviation -- is an economical, interpretable model of individual style, an alternative to per-player preference fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种残差式表征学习方法，通过将每个棋手的风格嵌入向量与棋力（Elo等级分）解耦，学习个体化的国际象棋风格表示。
AI.motivation: 现有棋手模型难以将"风格"与"水平"分离，作者希望学习一种与Elo解耦的、可衡量风格相似性的个体化嵌入表示。
AI.method: 构建一个以棋力为条件的基模型（结合Maia-3策略logits与Stockfish引擎特征），冻结该模型作为锚点，学习每个棋手的风格向量z，z仅解释偏离"典型水平棋手"的行为差异。
AI.result: 基模型在走子预测上比Maia-3提升27-37%的NLL；风格嵌入z在原始匹配率上增益不显著，但能泛化到未见数据、跨对局识别棋手，且z与Elo的线性回归R²仅0.06，证实了与棋力的解耦。
AI.conclusion: 一个强力的以棋力为条件的基模型加上紧凑的、与Elo解耦的风格嵌入，是一种经济、可解释的个体风格建模方案，可作为逐棋手偏好微调的有效替代。

title: Learning Perceptive Platform Adaptive Locomotion Controllers for Quadrupedal Robots
summary: Universal quadrupedal locomotion remains limited by the difficulty of integrating perception across diverse robot morphologies. State-of-the-art controllers rely on single-robot training or blind policies that omit real-time perception, leading to poor cross-embodiment generalization. Designing locomotion policies that remain robust across related quadruped morphologies while incorporating perception is challenging. Moreover, fully perceptive policies are often sensitive to noise, whereas blind controllers lack terrain awareness. In this work, we study how perception should be integrated into morphology-aware reinforcement learning architectures for deployable quadrupedal control. Building on MorAL, we train morphology-specialized universal controllers on multiple reference quadrupeds using adaptive terrain curricula. We compare a blind baseline, a critic-perceptive variant (MorAL+), and a fully perceptive actor-critic (PPAL). Policies are evaluated in simulation on flat and rough terrains, and deployed on ANYmal hardware. Results show that critic-only perception improves robustness and tracking consistency over blind baselines while remaining more stable than fully perceptive policies under perception noise. These findings highlight that perception placement and curriculum design are key factors for scalable, morphology-aware locomotion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何在形态感知强化学习框架中整合视觉感知，以提高四足机器人的跨形态泛化能力。通过对比盲策略、评论家感知策略（MorAL+）和全感知策略（PPAL），实验表明评论家层级的感知整合在鲁棒性和稳定性上优于盲策略和全感知策略。
AI.motivation: 现有四足运动控制器存在两大局限：一是依赖单机器人训练，无法跨形态泛化；二是盲策略缺乏实时感知，而全感知策略对噪声敏感。研究旨在探索如何将感知信息有效整合到形态感知的强化学习架构中。
AI.method: 基于MorAL框架，训练跨形态的通用控制器，使用自适应地形课程学习。设计了三种对比方案：盲基线、评论家感知变体（MorAL+，感知信息仅输入评论家网络）和全感知演员-评论家（PPAL，感知信息同时输入演员和评论家网络）。
AI.result: 在仿真（平坦和崎岖地形）和ANYmal硬件部署中，MorAL+（评论家仅感知）在鲁棒性和跟踪一致性上优于盲基线，且在感知噪声下比PPAL（全感知）更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 感知信息放置的位置（评论家层级 vs. 演员-评论家层级）以及课程设计是构建可扩展、形态感知运动控制的关键因素。评论家仅感知方案在跨形态泛化中兼顾了鲁棒性与稳定性。

title: Neural Network Quantization by Learning Low-Loss Subspaces
summary: Neural network quantization aims to find a discrete representation of parameters that preserves the performance of a full-precision (FP) model as faithfully as possible. Enforcing discrete constraints perturbs parameters away from a well-optimized minimum, generally resulting in performance degradation. Recent studies indicate that low-loss FP solutions are not isolated, but instead belong to connected low-loss subspaces of the loss landscape, where the loss maintains nearly the same minimum value. Models sampled from these subspaces are diverse and retain high accuracy. This raises the question: can a quantized model be constructed to lie within a low-loss subspace of the FP model, thereby automatically preserving performance? We address this question by learning quantization-aware linear paths in weight space optimized to minimize loss. We demonstrate that the midpoint of the resulting subspace is, by design, quantization-friendly and that its direct quantization yields performance comparable to that of quantization-aware training. The proposed procedure offers a novel perspective on weight quantization and, in contrast to conventional methods, neither relies on the straight-through estimator nor involves explicit discretization during training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过学习全精度模型低损失子空间中的量化友好路径，使得量化后的模型能自动位于低损失子空间内，从而无需传统量化感知训练即可保持高性能。
AI.motivation: 传统量化方法强制离散约束会导致参数偏离全精度模型已优化的最小值，造成性能下降。而研究发现全精度模型的低损失解存在于连通的低损失子空间中，因此作者希望利用这一特性，使量化模型直接落在该子空间内以自动保持性能。
AI.method: 通过学习权重空间中的量化感知线性路径（低损失子空间），并优化该路径以最小化损失函数，然后取其中点作为量化友好表示，直接对该中点进行量化得到高性能量化模型。
AI.result: 该子空间的中点天然具有量化友好特性，直接对其进行量化即可达到与传统量化感知训练相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为权重量化提供了全新视角，无需使用straight-through estimator，也无需在训练过程中进行显式离散化操作。

title: Transferability for General Reasoning: An Automated Curriculum for Multi-Domain RLVR
comment: 32 pages, including supplementary material; code available at https://github.com/YangYongJin/transfer-aware-curriculum
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been extended from single-domain training to multi-domain reasoning suites spanning mathematics, programming, and science. However, the training curriculum (how often each domain is sampled) is typically fixed or hand-tuned, even though reasoning skills transfer unevenly across domains. Existing learnability-based curricula adapt to where the policy is currently improving, but are blind to whether a gradient step on the selected domain benefits the remaining domains. In this paper, we propose Transfer-Aware Curriculum (TAC), a bandit-style online curriculum that prioritizes domains whose updates broadly benefit the rest of the training suite. TAC repurposes signals already produced by RL training: per-domain advantages capture local learnability, and projected gradients, taken from the GRPO step being computed, estimate cross-domain transferability via gradient-geometry alignment, at negligible cost (<1% wall-clock overhead). Across a six-domain reasoning suite, TAC achieves the best macro-averaged accuracy on both Qwen3-1.7B and Llama3.2-3B, outperforming proportional random sampling, a hand-designed schedule, and a learnability-only bandit, and improving over the last of these by up to 2.8 points (10% relative). Ablations show performance degrades sharply when the transferability term is removed, and TAC remains robust on imbalanced training mixtures where learnability-only curricula over-commit to dominant domains. Our findings establish cross-domain transferability as a key signal for curriculum design in multi-domain RLVR.

AI.tldr: 提出了Transfer-Aware Curriculum (TAC)，一种基于bandit的在线课程学习策略，通过感知跨域可迁移性来优化多领域强化学习中的训练课程，在不同规模模型上均取得最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR训练课程通常是固定或手工调整的，忽略了推理技能在不同领域间的不均匀迁移；现有的基于可学习性的课程虽然能适应策略当前改进的方向，但无法判断所选领域的梯度更新是否有利于其他领域。
AI.method: 提出TAC，一种bandit风格的在线课程策略。利用RL训练中已有的信号：每个领域的优势函数（advantage）衡量局部可学习性，投影梯度（从GRPO步骤中提取）通过梯度几何对齐估算跨域可迁移性，开销极低（<1%墙钟时间）。
AI.result: 在六个领域的推理套件上，TAC在Qwen3-1.7B和Llama3.2-3B上均取得最佳宏平均准确率，优于比例随机采样、手工设计调度和仅基于可学习性的bandit策略，最高提升2.8个点（相对提升10%）。移除可迁移性项后性能显著下降，在不平衡训练混合中TAC仍然稳健。
AI.conclusion: 跨域可迁移性是多领域RLVR课程设计的关键信号，TAC通过高效利用已有训练信号实现了性能提升和鲁棒性。

title: RAVEN: Long-Horizon Reasoning & Navigation with a Visuo-Spatio-Temporal Memory
summary: Long-term robot deployment requires a compact and scalable memory that preserves fine-grained visual semantics, grounds observations in space and time, and enables efficient storage and retrieval. In this paper, we propose RAVEN, an agentic memory system for long-horizon robotic question answering and navigation. RAVEN stores visual embeddings with pose and time in a vector database, and grounds retrieval in a spatial map to answer queries and navigate to goals. By operating directly on visual embeddings, RAVEN avoids lossy image-to-text captioning and enables accurate semantic, spatial, and temporal retrieval at scale. Across several simulated and real-world video question-answering benchmarks, RAVEN consistently surpasses caption-based memory systems and matches frontier VLMs on long-horizon tasks at 10$\times$ lower retrieval cost. Finally, we instantiate RAVEN on a Unitree Go1 robot for the task of long-horizon navigation for natural language goal-reaching, and show successful deployment over several large indoor environments.

AI.tldr: RAVEN是一个基于智能体记忆的系统，将视觉嵌入与位姿、时间存储在向量数据库中，通过空间地图检索实现长期机器人问答和导航，在多项基准测试中以10倍更低的检索成本超越基于标题的记忆系统。
AI.motivation: 长期机器人部署需要紧凑且可扩展的记忆系统，能够保留细粒度视觉语义、在时空上定位观察，并支持高效存储和检索，现有基于图像到文本标题的方法存在信息损失问题。
AI.method: 将视觉嵌入与位姿、时间信息一起存储在向量数据库中，将检索锚定在空间地图上，直接对视觉嵌入操作而非依赖图像到文本的标题生成。
AI.result: 在多个模拟和真实世界视频问答基准测试中，RAVEN持续超越基于标题的记忆系统，在长程任务上达到与前沿VLM相当的性能，检索成本降低10倍，并在真实机器人上成功部署。
AI.conclusion: RAVEN通过直接操作视觉嵌入避免信息损失，实现了大规模、准确的语义、空间和时间检索，为长期机器人部署提供了高效的记忆解决方案。

title: Reflective VLA: In-Context Action Consequences Make VLAs Generalize
summary: Most vision-language-action (VLA) models are reactive: they predict the next action from the current instruction and observation, implicitly assuming that the current observation fully specifies the action-relevant state. In embodied control, however, embodiment-specific factors such as camera-to-robot geometry, robot calibration, or systematic actuation bias are often hard to identify from a single observation. As a result, reactive policies cannot reliably disambiguate these factors in general, overfitting to training environments and generalizing poorly at deployment. We propose Reflective VLA, which conditions each decision on a context of observation-action-consequence triplets. Each triplet records not only what the robot observed and executed, but also how the scene changed afterward, exposing the deployment-specific mapping from actions to observed effects. Architecturally, Reflective VLA routes all observation modalities through the VLM under shared attention, so the action expert reasons directly over past triplets and the current observation. A block-causal mask enables parallel multi-frame training without leakage and supports KV-cached real-time inference. On standard LIBERO and SimplerEnv-Bridge, Reflective VLA preserves strong in-distribution performance. Under distribution shift on LIBERO-Plus and the harder LIBERO-Plus-Hard, it improves average success rate by 5.4 and 4.2 percentage points over a matched reactive baseline. Ablations with a matched history-only baseline further show that action consequences -- rather than additional context length alone -- are the key to cross-environment generalization. Project page: https://lianqing11.github.io/reflective-vla-page/

AI.tldr: Reflective VLA通过将动作-观测-后果三元组作为上下文条件，使VLA模型从反应式变为反思式，从而在分布偏移下提升泛化能力，在LIBERO-Plus和LIBERO-Plus-Hard上分别提升5.4和4.2个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型是反应式的，仅从当前观测预测动作，但单帧观测无法捕捉相机-机器人几何关系、标定误差等具身因素，导致过拟合训练环境、部署时泛化差。
AI.method: 提出Reflective VLA，将历史动作-观测-后果三元组作为决策上下文，通过共享注意力的VLM路由所有观测模态，并采用块因果掩码实现并行多帧训练和KV缓存实时推理。
AI.result: 在LIBERO和SimplerEnv-Bridge上保持强分布内性能；在LIBERO-Plus和LIBERO-Plus-Hard上分别提升5.4和4.2个百分点；消融实验证明动作后果是关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 反思式上下文（尤其是动作后果）比单纯增加历史长度更能提升跨环境泛化能力，为VLA模型处理分布偏移提供了有效范式。

title: To Isolate or to Score? Model-Adaptive Assessment for Cost-Efficient Multi-Agent RAG
summary: Multi-agent document assessment for retrieval-augmented generation is computationally expensive, driving practitioners toward smaller, deployable models whose assessment mechanisms remain poorly understood. We conduct a controlled study of training-free interventions on 7B-9B instruction-tuned models across diverse QA benchmarks, revealing a sharp dichotomy in how models benefit from assessment. For weaker baselines, the dominant mechanism is per-document isolation. Astoundingly, assessment-free isolation matches full multi-agent assessment, demonstrating that resolving multi-document context confusion, rather than scoring quality, drives outsized gains of up to 50 percentage points. Conversely, for strong baselines where scoring quality matters, we introduce Reasoning-Score Coupling, a label-free perturbation probe that classifies scoring behavior. Integrating these findings, we propose MADARA, a model-adaptive routing architecture. Crucially, MADARA's diagnostic thresholds derived from a single pilot model generalize zero-shot to four unseen model families, providing a robust, lightweight pipeline to eliminate computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了检索增强生成中多智能体文档评估的计算开销问题，发现弱基线模型的主要收益来自多文档上下文混淆的消除而非评分质量，并提出了一种轻量级模型自适应路由架构MADARA，可在零样本下推广到未见模型。
AI.motivation: 多智能体文档评估在检索增强生成中计算成本高昂，促使研究者转向小型可部署模型，但这些模型的评估机制尚不明确，需要深入理解其工作原理以优化效率。
AI.method: 对7B-9B指令微调模型进行受控实验，通过干预训练-free的方法研究评估机制；提出Reasoning-Score Coupling扰动探针分类评分行为；构建MADARA模型自适应路由架构。
AI.result: 弱基线模型的核心收益来自每文档隔离机制，消除多文档上下文混淆可带来高达50个百分点的提升；强基线模型则依赖评分质量。
AI.conclusion: MADARA的诊断阈值可从单个导引模型零样本推广到四个未见模型族，提供鲁棒且轻量级的流水线以消除计算开销。

title: Wear-Clearance-Impact Coupling in the Jansen Linkage: A Gait-Durability-Optimized Design Slows Joint Loosening
summary: A companion study introduced joint durability into the dimensional design of the Theo Jansen walking linkage and found its classical "holy numbers" Pareto-dominated, but it modelled the revolute joints as ideal, clearance-free pins, so its wear figures were relative rankings, not a prediction of in-service degradation. Here we relax that idealization. We build a forward-dynamic model of the Jansen leg in which a revolute joint becomes a clearance joint with a continuous normal contact law (Lankarani-Flores, hysteresis-damped) and Ambrosio friction, integrated as a constraint-stabilized differential-algebraic system, and couple it to the Archard law in a wear->clearance->impact feedback loop. Three findings emerge. First, neglecting clearance underestimates the peak joint load: the clearance model gives a peak contact force of ~104 N at the load-bearing pin against ~48 N for the ideal joint (~2x amplification), rising to ~426 N when two joints carry clearance at once. Second, the coupling is strongly impact-sensitive--single trajectories are non-monotonic and can reverse the design ranking, a chaos consistent with the literature--so designs must be compared statistically; over an ensemble of 16 randomized phases the optimized joint is robustly more durable, with per-cycle wear ~9-7x lower (peak force ~4x lower) at one clearance joint and still ~1.7x lower on both with two (p<0.01 throughout). Third, the wear is strongly non-uniform--it concentrates on a ~10 deg load arc--so assuming uniform clearance growth underestimates local clearance growth by ~36x. The clearance-free durability advantage thus survives the chaotic, multi-joint, non-uniformly-worn coupling in the ensemble mean. We deliver the first clearance-coupled forward-dynamic model of the Jansen leg and specify a falsifiable protocol to test each prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文在Theo Jansen行走机构的铰链中引入间隙模型（Lankarani-Flores接触力+Ambrosio摩擦+Archard磨损），发现：无间隙模型低估峰值载荷约2倍；磨损高度非均匀，集中在约10度载荷弧上；优化设计在统计意义上鲁棒性更强（磨损低~9-7倍）。
AI.motivation: 先前研究将关节理想化为无间隙理想销钉，仅给出磨损的相对排名，无法预测实际服役中的退化行为。本文放松该理想化假设，建立含间隙的动力学模型以更真实地评估磨损。
AI.method: 构建Jansen腿的前向动力学模型，将旋转关节建模为含间隙关节，采用Lankarani-Flores连续法向接触律（含迟滞阻尼）和Ambrosio摩擦力，集成约束稳定化的微分-代数系统，并耦合Archard磨损定律形成磨损→间隙→冲击的反馈回路。采用16个随机相位系综进行统计分析。
AI.result: (1) 间隙模型峰值接触力约104 N，无间隙模型约48 N（~2倍放大），双关节间隙时达~426 N；(2) 耦合对冲击高度敏感，单轨迹非单调且可反转设计排名，但系综平均下优化设计磨损低~9-7倍（单间隙）和~1.7倍（双间隙），p<0.01；(3) 磨损集中在~10度载荷弧上，均匀间隙假设低估局部间隙增长约36倍。
AI.conclusion: 无间隙假设下的耐久性优势在混沌、多关节、非均匀磨损耦合的系综平均中仍然成立。文章首次提供了Jansen腿的含间隙耦合前向动力学模型，并提出了可证伪的实验验证协议。

title: Cage-based Texture Transfer with Geometric Filtering
summary: Real-time texture transfer expands the creative horizon for interactive applications, enabling seamless detail projection in scenarios that range from digital character cosmetics to procedural automotive texturing. Yet, its practical application is governed by inherent trade-offs between processing speed and suppression of artifacts. Low-latency transfer methods frequently fail to suppress artifacts, and robust alternatives rely on large-scale models that are costly in training and memory. Our proposed method bridges the gap between efficiency and robustness by using a cage-based geometric filtering method to identify Non-Cosmetic Zones (NCZs) for artifact suppression. While other models are resource-intensive and require multiple days of training on manually annotated datasets, we are able to successfully suppress artifacts and achieve immediate deployment on consumer-grade hardware. Our framework achieved highly efficient runtimes of ~70ms on mobile devices for a ~4.8k triangle mesh.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于笼形几何滤波的实时纹理迁移方法，通过识别非化妆品区域（NCZs）来抑制伪影，在不需大规模训练的情况下实现了高效、鲁棒的纹理迁移，在移动设备上对约4.8k三角网格仅需约70ms。
AI.motivation: 现有实时纹理迁移方法在速度与伪影抑制之间存在权衡：低延迟方法伪影严重，而鲁棒方法依赖大规模模型，训练成本高、内存开销大，难以在消费级硬件上部署。
AI.method: 提出基于笼形几何滤波（cage-based geometric filtering）的方法，识别非化妆品区域（Non-Cosmetic Zones, NCZs）用于伪影抑制，无需手动标注数据集和长时间训练。
AI.result: 在移动设备上对约4.8k三角网格实现了约70ms的高效运行时间，成功抑制伪影，可在消费级硬件上即时部署。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在效率与鲁棒性之间取得了良好平衡，无需大规模训练即可实现实时纹理迁移与伪影抑制，具有实际应用价值。

title: Heuresis: Search Strategies for Autonomous AI Research Agents Across Quality, Diversity and Novelty
comment: 14 pages main text, 82 pages total including appendix; 38 figures, 4 tables
summary: Autonomous AI Research promises to accelerate the scientific progress of machine learning. To realise this goal, current Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents need to go beyond just writing code, to mastering the exploration of simultaneously performant, diverse and novel ideas. To this end, we introduce Heuresis, a framework that abstracts the research pipeline into a set of general and composable primitives, enabling open-ended scientific exploration in machine learning research. We implement six search strategies: a greedy baseline, two archive-based (MAP-Elites, Go-Explore), one evolutionary (Islands), and two divergent (Curiosity, Omni), and evaluate them across three axes (Quality, Diversity, and Novelty) on three domains (LLM Pretraining, On-Policy RL, and Model Unlearning), totalling 3,222 scored runs. We find that completely novel ideas are rare. No idea across our scored runs is rated as "Original", and only a few achieve only "Minor Similarity" to prior work. Moreover, novel ideas never approach the highest-performing known-recipe scores. Across all six strategies and three domains, only one such idea lands in the top-10 by quality. We also observed agents resorting to a variety of reward-hacking techniques during execution (40 confirmed fabrications across 1,628 scored runs), and detecting them was necessary to keep the search faithful to the task. Our results show that while current search and Quality-Diversity strategies enable us to steer where the generated ideas land on the quality, diversity, and novelty axes, they do not expand the quality-novelty frontier. Bridging this gap is the open challenge towards the ultimate goal of perpetual, autonomous scientific progress. Code is available at github.com/a-antoniades/Heuresis.

AI.tldr: Heuresis是一个将机器学习研究流程抽象为可组合原语的框架，实验发现当前策略虽能调控生成想法的质量、多样性和新颖性，但无法扩展质量-新颖性前沿，且完全新颖的想法极为罕见。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的AI研究智能体局限于写代码，缺乏对同时具备高性能、多样性和新颖性的想法的探索能力。需要一种框架来实现开放式的科学探索。
AI.method: 提出Heuresis框架，将研究流程抽象为通用可组合原语。实现了6种搜索策略（贪心基线、MAP-Elites、Go-Explore、Islands、Curiosity、Omni），在3个领域（LLM预训练、在线RL、模型去学习）共3,222次评分实验中进行评估。
AI.result: 完全新颖的想法极为罕见，无任何实验被评为"原创"，仅有少数达到"微小相似度"。新颖想法从未接近已知最优性能。仅有一个新颖想法进入质量前十。发现了40起确认的奖励欺骗行为。
AI.conclusion: 当前搜索和QD策略能引导想法在质量、多样性和新颖性轴上的分布，但无法扩展质量-新颖性前沿。如何弥合这一差距是实现自主持续科学进步的关键挑战。

title: RigPI: Dynamic Parameter Identification of Rigid Body via VLM-Seeded Differentiable Simulation
comment: Accepted to IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2027)
summary: Accurate physical parameter identification of manipulated objects is fundamental to advanced robotic manipulation and the construction of faithful digital twins. However, acquiring physically consistent inertial and frictional properties from real-world interactions remains challenging due to sensing noise, modeling errors, and limited prior knowledge. This paper presents \textbf{RigPI}, a systematic framework for identifying dynamic parameters of both unconstrained rigid bodies and multi-link rigid bodies during robot-object interaction. RigPI integrates vision-based semantic priors, force-torque measurements, and motion observations within a differentiable simulation pipeline. A vision-language model (VLM) provides informed initialization and a constrained search space, while gradient information from a differentiable physics simulator enables efficient and stable parameter refinement. The proposed two-stage optimization strategy alleviates sensitivity to noise and avoids physically implausible solutions. Extensive real-world experiments on objects with revolute and prismatic joints demonstrate that RigPI achieves accurate and stable parameter estimates, and successfully reproduces manipulation trajectories on a real robot with parameter-aware predictive validity. These results highlight the effectiveness and robustness of RigPI for real-world robotic system identification tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RigPI，一个结合视觉语言模型和可微物理模拟器的系统框架，用于从真实机器人交互中识别刚体和多连杆刚体的动力学参数（惯性和摩擦特性），通过两阶段优化策略实现了高精度和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 解决真实机器人操作中物理参数识别面临的传感噪声、建模误差和先验知识有限等挑战，为高级机器人操作和数字孪生构建提供准确的物理参数。
AI.method: 集成视觉语言模型（VLM）提供初始化与约束搜索空间，结合可微物理模拟器的梯度信息进行参数优化，采用两阶段优化策略抑制噪声影响、避免物理不可行解。
AI.result: 在真实世界的旋转关节和滑动关节物体上，RigPI实现了准确稳定的参数估计，并在真实机器人上成功复现了具有参数感知预测有效性的操作轨迹。
AI.conclusion: RigPI在真实机器人系统辨识任务中展现了有效性和鲁棒性，能够为机器人操作提供物理一致的参数估计。

title: MJEPA: A Simple and Scalable Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Audio-Visual Learning
summary: Self-supervised learning from large-scale video data has emerged as a dominant paradigm for visual representation learning. Since audio and visual streams naturally co-occur in video data, extending this success to jointly learn from both modalities is a natural next step, yet it remains challenging. Existing audio-visual self-supervised methods rely on modality-specific encoders and complex combinations of contrastive or reconstruction objectives, limiting cross-modal synergy and scalability. Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) offer a simple, modality-agnostic alternative, but have to date been applied primarily to individual modalities. We introduce MJEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architecture for audio-visual learning that uses a single, unified encoder for both modalities. Our approach uses only a single predictive objective, applied both within and across modalities. We show that cross-modal prediction is critical: without it, a shared encoder degrades below unimodal baselines; with it, each modality's representation benefits from the other. Our frozen ViT-g model outperforms the best prior frozen baseline by over 6.8 mAP on AudioSet-20K, surpasses fully finetuned models on ESC-50 and FSD50K, and is competitive on video benchmarks despite using 10x less video data.

AI.tldr: MJEPA提出了一种统一的单编码器联合嵌入预测架构，通过跨模态预测实现音频-视觉自监督学习，在多个基准上超越先前方法。
AI.motivation: 现有音频-视觉自监督方法依赖模态特定编码器和复杂的对比/重建目标，限制了跨模态协同和可扩展性；而JEPA虽简单，但此前仅用于单模态。
AI.method: 提出MJEPA，使用单一统一编码器处理双模态，仅采用一个预测目标，在模态内和跨模态间同时应用，关键创新在于跨模态预测。
AI.result: 冻结ViT-g模型在AudioSet-20K上超越最佳先前冻结基线6.8 mAP，在ESC-50和FSD50K上超越全微调模型，视频基准上使用10倍更少数据仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态预测对于共享编码器至关重要，能提升各模态表示质量；统一的单编码器架构有效且高效。

title: Omni-Perception Policy Optimization for Multimodal Emotion Reasoning
summary: We find that current emotion-oriented Omni-MLLMs still lack reliable omni-modal perception: they (i) underutilize multimodal cues in their reasoning trajectories and (ii) exhibit unfaithful behavior, often hallucinating modality-specific statements from other modalities. Building on these insights, we propose OPPO (Omni-Perception Policy Optimization), a reinforcement learning framework that explicitly optimizes multimodal perception. First, an Omni-Perception Reward decomposes ground-truth reasoning into fine-grained visual, acoustic, and emotion cues and rewards trajectories that semantically recover these cues. Second, an Omni-Perception Loss compares the policy under full and unimodally masked inputs, applying a KL penalty only to modality-specific evidence tokens to suppress cross-modal hallucination. We further introduce MEP-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that quantifies utilization and faithfulness. Experiments show that OPPO achieves state-of-the-art performance on MER-UniBench and MME-Emotion, while substantially improving utilization and faithfulness scores on MEP-Bench, highlighting the importance of sufficient and faithful omni perception for multimodal emotion reasoning.

AI.tldr: 针对当前情感导向的全模态大语言模型缺乏可靠的全模态感知问题（对多模态线索利用不足、存在跨模态幻觉），作者提出OPPO强化学习框架：通过全模态感知奖励分解细粒度视觉/声学/情感线索，以及全模态感知损失对模态特定证据token施加KL惩罚来抑制幻觉。同时构建MEP-Bench诊断基准。实验表明OPPO在多模态情感推理任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 当前情感导向的全模态大语言模型存在两个关键缺陷：(i)推理轨迹中未能充分利用多模态线索；(ii)行为不可靠，经常从其他模态幻觉出模态特定的陈述。因此需要显式优化全模态感知能力。
AI.method: 提出OPPO框架：(1) Omni-Perception Reward：将真实推理分解为细粒度的视觉、声学和情感线索，奖励能语义恢复这些线索的轨迹；(2) Omni-Perception Loss：比较完整输入与单模态遮蔽输入下的策略，仅对模态特定证据token施加KL散度惩罚以抑制跨模态幻觉。同时构建MEP-Bench诊断基准量化利用率和忠实度。
AI.result: 在MER-UniBench和MME-Emotion上达到SOTA性能；在MEP-Bench上显著提升了利用率和忠实度分数。
AI.conclusion: 充分且忠实的多模态感知对于情感推理至关重要，OPPO通过强化学习显式优化全模态感知能有效提升模型表现。

title: Swazure: Swarm Measurement of Pose for Flying Light Specks
