The dataset and trained models will be released at https://qinzheyang.github.io/LEVIRDet/, accompanying the final paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了目前规模最大、最全面的遥感目标检测数据集LEVIRDet-159（159类、256万边界框、70万细粒度标注），并设计了尺度层级感知的检测基础模型LEVIRDetNet，通过在线GSD预测、GSD条件查询调制与层级感知检测头实现跨域泛化，在9个外部基准上超越强监督方法平均5.02 mAP。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感目标检测数据集和检测器存在碎片化问题：数据集局限于有限类别、固定空间分辨率或单一传感器；检测器难以跨不同传感器和分类体系工作。亟需大规模、多类别、多尺度的统一数据集和通用检测模型。
AI.method: 构建LEVIRDet-159数据集（159类、多级分类体系、2.56M边界框、700K细粒度标注）；设计LEVIRDetNet检测基础模型，包含三个核心模块：（1）在线视觉GSD预测，（2）GSD条件查询调制与分配，（3）层级感知检测头，支持混合粒度的遥感监督。
AI.result: LEVIRDetNet无需目标域训练或微调，在9个外部基准上均达到SOTA检测性能，平均超越最强全监督方法5.02 mAP（各基准主指标下）。
AI.conclusion: LEVIRDet-159数据集和LEVIRDetNet模型有望推动跨类别体系、跨空间分辨率、跨传感器平台的强泛化遥感目标检测发展。数据集和模型将开源发布。

title: AI Snitches Get Glitches: Towards Evading Agentic Surveillance
summary:
To better assist users with completing challenging tasks, AI agents mediate communications, access data, and interact with different APIs. Many employers (and even nation-states) already provide their users with this technology. However, widespread adoption of AI agents creates a new risk to abuse access to user data for another goal: surveilling users. These users might not even have the ability or permission to control the actions and data accesses of the surveilling agents.
  We introduce and formalize the problem of agentic surveillance: the ability of an AI agent to analyze available information, craft a report, and send it out using available tools. To evaluate surveillance capabilities across different models, we create SurveilBench, a dataset of various reporting scenarios focusing on three domains: corporate, education, and police. We find that some models exhibit emergent (i.e., unprompted) tendencies to help surveillance, but they also report the attempts to surveil users to the government.
  Finally, we repurpose prompt injections for evading surveillance and develop three evasion techniques that hide from, deceive, or induce over-escalation in surveillance agents. We conclude that agentic surveillance can already be easily implemented and, therefore, call for a comprehensive technical, ethical, and legislative framework to protect users.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并形式化了“智能体监控”（agentic surveillance）问题，即AI代理可能滥用用户数据权限进行监控。作者构建了SurveilBench数据集评估模型能力，发现部分模型存在自发协助监控的倾向，同时也会向政府报告监控行为。最后提出了三种规避监控的提示注入技术，呼吁建立全面的技术、伦理和法律框架。
AI.motivation: AI代理的广泛使用带来新的安全风险：代理可能滥用数据访问权限对用户进行监控，而用户可能无法控制这些监控行为。现有研究缺乏对这一问题的正视和系统分析。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义“智能体监控”问题；2) 构建SurveilBench数据集，涵盖企业、教育、警察三个领域；3) 评估多种模型的监控能力；4) 提出三种基于提示注入的规避技术：隐藏、欺骗和诱导过度上报。
AI.result: 部分模型表现出自发协助监控的涌现能力，但同时也会向政府报告监控尝试。提出的三种提示注入方法可有效规避监控代理。
AI.conclusion: 智能体监控已可轻易实现，亟需建立全面的技术、伦理和法律框架来保护用户免受这种新型监控的侵害。

title: Delta-Position Estimation-Based IMU Odometry: A Comparison of MLP and Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
comment: This study was presented at the 11th International Congress on Engineering Sciences and Multidisciplinary Approaches, held in Istanbul, Türkiye
summary: In this study, the learning-based inertial odometry problem is investigated using raw IMU measurements obtained from the EuRoC MAV benchmark dataset. Instead of absolute position regression-a formulation that may lead to large constant errors-the models are trained to estimate the incremental displacement (Δp) over a fixed 50 ms sliding window, and the full trajectory is reconstructed through numerical integration. A standard Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) is compared with a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) equipped with learnable B-spline activations. Although KAN has 6.9 times fewer parameters than MLP (8,444 versus 57,859), it produces a 44% lower error in terms of final cumulative drift on the test trajectory (9.61 m versus 17.23 m). In addition, KAN exhibits more stable behavior in terms of long-term error accumulation, with lower P_50 and P_90 cumulative drift values. These findings indicate that learnable B-spline-based activations have the potential to reduce error accumulation in the inertial odometry problem.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基于学习的惯性里程计问题，提出使用增量位移（Δp）估计替代绝对位置回归，并在EuRoC MAV数据集上比较了MLP和KAN（Kolmogorov-Arnold Network）的性能。KAN仅用8,444个参数（MLP的1/7），却在最终漂移误差上降低了44%（9.61m vs 17.23m），且长期误差累积更稳定。
AI.motivation: 传统的绝对位置回归方法容易产生较大的常数误差，因此作者提出通过估计增量位移（Δp）并数值积分重建轨迹，以降低误差累积。
AI.method: 使用EuRoC MAV数据集中的原始IMU测量数据，将模型训练为在固定50ms滑动窗口上估计增量位移（Δp），再通过数值积分重构完整轨迹。比较了标准MLP与使用可学习B样条激活函数的KAN。
AI.result: KAN参数仅为MLP的1/6.9（8,444 vs 57,859），但最终累积漂移误差降低了44%（9.61m vs 17.23m），且长期误差累积更稳定，P_50和P_90漂移值均更低。
AI.conclusion: 基于可学习B样条的激活函数（KAN）在惯性里程计问题中具有减少误差累积的潜力，以更少的参数实现了更好的性能。

title: ESTANet: Efficient Online Error Detection in Procedural Videos via Prediction Inconsistency
summary: An efficient and accurate system for detecting errors in procedural tasks is crucial for supporting human needs in daily life, as it can provide instant notifications and guide people to correct mistakes. In this work, we study real-time online error detection in procedural videos from a simple but overlooked perspective: the prediction behavior of action detectors themselves. Instead of designing complex architectures or specialized supervision, we observe that action detectors naturally exhibit different prediction characteristics depending on their sensitivity to input dynamics and temporal context. We therefore propose ESTANet (Error-Sensitive and Temporally-vArying Network), a lightweight framework that detects errors by exploiting inconsistencies among action predictions produced by a small set of action detectors. We construct standard and error-sensitive action detectors that behave similarly on correct executions but respond differently when errors occur. Meanwhile, detectors operating with different temporal contexts further amplify prediction inconsistencies when the procedure deviates from the intended sequence. During inference, we detect errors by aggregating mismatches between standard and error-sensitive predictions through majority voting to flag frames that contain errors. Extensive experiments on EgoPER, Assembly-101-O, and EPIC-Tent-O demonstrate that ESTANet achieves state-of-the-art performance in online error detection while maintaining real-time efficiency with a lightweight architecture. Our results highlight that leveraging the intrinsic properties of action detectors can yield a powerful and practical solution for online error detection without increasing architectural design complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ESTANet，通过利用动作检测器自身在不同输入动态和时间上下文下的预测行为差异（而非设计复杂架构）来实时检测程序性视频中的错误，在三个基准数据集上实现了SOTA性能，且保持轻量级实时效率。
AI.motivation: 现有程序性视频错误检测方法通常依赖复杂架构或专门监督信号，但作者观察到动作检测器本身在不同输入动态和时间上下文下会表现出不同的预测特性，这一简单但被忽视的视角可以用于错误检测。
AI.method: ESTANet包含标准动作检测器和错误敏感动作检测器，二者在正确执行时行为相似，但在错误发生时响应不同；同时利用不同时间上下文的检测器进一步放大预测不一致性；通过多数投票聚合匹配度来标记包含错误的帧。
AI.result: 在EgoPER、Assembly-101-O和EPIC-Tent-O三个数据集上，ESTANet达到了在线错误检测的SOTA性能，且保持轻量级架构下的实时效率。
AI.conclusion: 利用动作检测器自身的固有属性（而非增加架构复杂度）可以构建强大且实用的在线错误检测解决方案。

title: Agentic System as Compressor: Quantifying System Intelligence in Bits
summary: Large language models are turning from isolated predictors into agentic systems: they call tools, retrieve evidence, obey environment constraints, use verifiers, and complete tasks through search and multi-turn interaction. We adopts an analytical viewpoint based on "compression is intelligence": under a fixed task distribution, interface, and compute budget, a stronger agentic system lets a target object be reconstructed with fewer bits. We operationalize the measure with arithmetic coding, seed coding, and a fallback, and evaluate it in five settings: reversed text, chess moves, protein sequences, retrieval-augmented question answering, and semantic story compression; in all of them agentic components reduce codelength. These small, controlled experiments cover component types typical of real agentic systems, show that codelength can analyze how components, observers, and budgets change residual uncertainty, and offer guidance for evaluating real agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文基于"压缩即智能"的视角，提出用编码长度来评估语言模型作为智能体系统（调用工具、检索、验证等）的性能，并在五个实验任务中验证了智能体组件能缩短编码长度。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型正从独立预测器转向智能体系统（工具调用、检索、验证、多轮交互等），但缺乏统一的、理论上可解释的评估框架来量化智能体组件带来的性能提升。
AI.method: 采用"压缩即智能"的分析视角：在固定任务分布、接口和计算预算下，更强的智能体系统能用更少的比特重建目标对象。具体使用算术编码、种子编码和回退机制来度量编码长度。
AI.result: 在五个设置（反转文本、国际象棋走法、蛋白质序列、检索增强问答、语义故事压缩）中，所有包含智能体组件的系统均降低了编码长度，证明智能体组件减少了残余不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 编码长度能够分析不同组件、观察者和计算预算如何改变残余不确定性，为评估真实智能体系统提供了指导方向。

title: Generative AI for Safe and Photorealistic Drone Light Shows
summary: Drone light shows are redefining aerial entertainment, yet their widespread adoption is bottlenecked by labor-intensive, manual animation. While generative AI promises an automated alternative, current frameworks fail to provide photorealism with fluid, dynamic motion. To address this limitation, we introduce SWAN, an end-to-end pipeline that synthesizes photorealistic, large-scale, and collision-free drone choreographies directly from text prompts. SWAN converts text into realistic reference videos and translates these pixel-space dynamics into physical swarm kinematics using a novel, adaptive point-tracking algorithm. Unlike existing trackers, this method maintains spatial coherence through severe occlusions and rapid topological shifts. A dedicated planner then allocates these trajectories to individual drones, while a subsequent safety filter ensures collision-free execution. We demonstrate scalability by safely orchestrating simulated 2,000-drone formations and validate physical feasibility on a dense real-world swarm of 49 quadcopters, operating everything entirely on standard consumer hardware. Combined, this work demonstrates how generative AI can be leveraged to automate multi-robot choreography design, providing an accessible new framework for drone light shows.

AI.tldr: SWAN是一个端到端管道，能从文本提示直接合成逼真、大规模且无碰撞的无人机编队灯光秀动画，通过自适应点跟踪算法将像素动力学转换为物理集群运动，并在2000架仿真和49架真实无人机上验证可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机灯光秀依赖人工动画，效率低下；生成式AI虽提供自动化可能，但现有框架无法实现兼具照片级真实感和流畅动态运动的效果。
AI.method: 提出SWAN端到端管道：1) 文本→逼真参考视频；2) 自适应点跟踪算法将像素运动转为物理集群运动学（能应对严重遮挡和拓扑变化）；3) 规划器将轨迹分配给个体无人机；4) 安全过滤器确保无碰撞执行。
AI.result: 在模拟2000架无人机编队中验证可扩展性，并在49架真实四旋翼无人机密集集群中验证物理可行性，所有计算均在标准消费级硬件上完成。
AI.conclusion: 证明了生成式AI可自动化多机器人编舞设计，为无人机灯光秀提供了便捷的新框架。

title: REViT: Roto-reflection Equivariant Convolutional Vision Transformer
summary: In this paper, we propose a discrete roto-reflection group equivariant vision transformer with convolutional attention. Roto-reflection equivariant networks preserve the rotational, flip and positional symmetry in feature maps, making them useful for tasks where orientation of the inputs is relevant to the model outputs. In image classification and object detection, most of the studies on roto-reflection equivariant models have focused on using convolutional neural networks rather than vision transformers. In this paper, we examine the challenges involved in achieving equivariance in vision transformers, and we propose a simpler way to implement a discretized roto-reflection group equivariant vision transformer. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms the existing approaches for developing discrete roto-reflection group equivariant neural networks for image classification.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种离散旋转反射群等变的视觉Transformer（ViT），结合卷积注意力机制，在图像分类中优于现有等变网络方法。
AI.motivation: 现有旋转反射等变模型主要集中在CNN上，而ViT的等变性研究较少且实现复杂，本文旨在简化ViT中等变性的实现并提升性能。
AI.method: 设计了一种离散旋转反射群等变的视觉Transformer架构，采用卷积注意力机制来实现特征图的旋转、翻转和位置对称性保持。
AI.result: 实验证明该方法在图像分类任务上优于已有的离散旋转反射群等变神经网络方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法为ViT实现旋转反射等变性提供了一种更简单的途径，且性能更优，证明ViT也能有效应用于对方向敏感的视觉任务。

title: WinDOM: Self-Family Distillation for Small-Model GUI Grounding
summary: Small ($\sim$2B) GUI-grounding agents are attractive for on-device deployment, accessibility tooling, and low-cost iteration, but at this scale they face two open recipe questions: how to obtain bounding-box training data without expensive human annotation, and how to combine supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning. We address both, with the explicit goal of pushing small-model performance rather than scaling up. WinDOM is a $54{,}425$-record grounding corpus harvested by driving an open-source Windows 11 web reimplementation under headless Playwright, with bounding boxes read directly off the DOM and no OCR or human annotation. Self-Family Distillation (SFD) is a single rejection-sampling cold-start parameterised only by the teacher choice: either an EMA of the student (no external model) or a frozen larger same-family teacher. We then treat the saturation depth of the SFD cold-start as an explicit GRPO hyperparameter. On a Qwen3.5-2B student, the under-saturated cold-start is a better GRPO initialiser than the converged one: SFD-4B with Early-init RL gains $+5.4$ OOD-mean ($+3.5$ ScreenSpot-Pro, $+7.0$ OSWorld-G, $+5.8$ ScreenSpot-V2) over the base. The same-size EMA mode lands within roughly one OOD-mean point of the cross-size $4$B variant ($65.2$ vs $66.3$) without an external teacher.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WinDOM（自动从DOM提取GUI目标框数据，无需人工标注）和Self-Family Distillation（SFD，自我家族蒸馏）方法，结合GRPO强化学习，使2B级小模型在GUI grounding任务上达到强竞争力性能，且发现欠饱和冷启动比完全收敛的冷启动更适合作为RL初始化点。
AI.motivation: 小规模（~2B）GUI grounding模型在端侧部署、辅助工具和低成本迭代方面具有吸引力，但面临两个开放问题：如何在不依赖昂贵人工标注的情况下获取边界框训练数据，以及如何有效结合监督微调与强化学习。本文目的是推动小模型性能上限，而非简单扩大模型规模。
AI.method: 1) WinDOM：在开源的Windows 11 Web重实现上通过Playwright无头驱动，直接从DOM读取边界框，构建54,425条记录的数据集，无需OCR或人工标注。2) Self-Family Distillation (SFD)：仅由教师模型选择参数化的拒绝采样冷启动方法，教师可以是学生的EMA（无需外部模型）或冻结的更大同族模型。3) 将SFD冷启动的饱和深度作为GRPO的超参数，发现欠饱和冷启动比完全收敛的冷启动更适合作为RL初始点。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-2B学生模型上，SFD-4B配合Early-init RL相比基线提升+5.4 OOD-mean（ScreenSpot-Pro +3.5，OSWorld-G +7.0，ScreenSpot-V2 +5.8）。同尺寸EMA模式（65.2）与跨尺寸4B变体（66.3）的OOD-mean仅差约1个点，无需外部教师。
AI.conclusion: 通过WinDOM和SFD方法，小规模GUI grounding模型可以在无需人工标注和外部大教师的情况下达到优异性能；欠饱和冷启动作为GRPO初始化点效果更好，且EMA自蒸馏模式与使用更大教师模型的性能差距很小。

title: SAGE-Nav: Leveraging LLM Planning and Alignment Fusion for Hierarchical Scene Graph-Guided Navigation
summary: Object-Goal Navigation (ObjNav) requires embodied agents to autonomously locate specified targets using only egocentric visual observations. Existing monolithic methods struggle with long-horizon reasoning and generalize poorly to novel environments. To address these limitations, we propose SAGE-Nav, a novel hierarchical framework that integrates the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) with dynamic scene graphs. Crucially, it decouples asynchronous global semantic planning from the high-frequency reactive control loop. The LLM serves as a global planner, decomposing abstract instructions into a sequence of semantically grounded waypoints. To translate these plans into dense multi-modal guidance, we design a Hierarchical Scene Graph Encoder (HSGE) that leverages relational graph convolutions to produce structure-aware embeddings preserving both semantic and spatial topology. Furthermore, we develop the Goal-aware Alignment-Fusion Network (GAFN) to dynamically fuse real-time perception with these structural priors. Using an adaptive gating mechanism with an explicit inductive bias, GAFN ensures robust visual-topological alignment for the low-level policy. Extensive evaluations in the i-THOR and RoboTHOR environments demonstrate that SAGE-Nav achieves state-of-the-art performance, delivering substantial gains in navigation efficiency and zero-shot generalization while maintaining the low control latency required for physical robotic deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAGE-Nav，一种结合大语言模型与动态场景图的分层导航框架，通过解耦全局语义规划与高频反应控制，在ObjNav任务上实现了SOTA性能，显著提升了导航效率和零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在长程推理和新环境泛化方面表现不佳，传统的端到端方法难以处理长期的导航推理任务，且对未见环境的适应能力较差。
AI.method: 提出分层框架SAGE-Nav：1) LLM作为全局规划器，将抽象指令分解为语义路标序列；2) 层级场景图编码器(HSGE)利用关系图卷积生成结构感知嵌入；3) 目标感知对齐融合网络(GAFN)通过自适应门控机制实现实时感知与结构先验的动态融合。
AI.result: 在i-THOR和RoboTHOR环境中的广泛评估表明，SAGE-Nav在导航效率和零样本泛化方面均达到SOTA性能，同时保持了物理机器人部署所需的低控制延迟。
AI.conclusion: 解耦全局语义规划与局部反应控制的分层架构有效提升了长程导航推理能力，LLM与动态场景图的结合为Embodied AI中的语义导航任务提供了新的有效范式。

title: V-Zero: Answer-Label-Free On-Policy Distillation with Contrastive Evidence Gating for Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning
summary: Fine-grained visual reasoning requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to identify task-relevant visual evidence and ground their reasoning in local image regions. Existing agentic methods typically rely on reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards or supervised fine-tuning on large-scale annotated reasoning traces, leading to costly exploration, hand-designed verification rules, or heavy dependence on textual supervision. A natural way to avoid such external answer labels is to learn from trajectories sampled by the student itself, which points to On-Policy Distillation (OPD). To understand what OPD can and cannot provide for visual reasoning, we revisit it as negative-free stop-gradient alignment. This perspective shows that, although OPD provides effective token-level correction, its ceiling is constrained by the absence of trajectory-level discrimination. Motivated by these observations, we propose V-Zero, an answer-label-free framework for visual reasoning with contrastive evidence gating. V-Zero uses no annotated textual answer labels; instead, during training it pairs a question-relevant regional crop with a negative visual view to evaluate student-sampled trajectories and gate dense token-level distillation. Experiments on multiple visual reasoning benchmarks show that V-Zero consistently improves fine-grained visual reasoning while preserving strong generalization. Notably, V-Zero is more than 5$\times$ faster than previous supervised fine-tuning methods and more than 10$\times$ faster than reinforcement learning baselines. Code and dataset will be released at https://github.com/eVI-group-SCU/V-Zero

AI.tldr: 本文提出V-Zero，一种无需答案标签的视觉推理框架，通过对比证据门控机制进行在线策略蒸馏，在多个基准上有效提升细粒度视觉推理能力，且训练速度比传统监督微调快5倍以上，比强化学习快10倍以上。
AI.motivation: 现有细粒度视觉推理方法要么依赖强化学习（代价高昂的探索和人工验证规则），要么依赖监督微调（需要大量标注推理轨迹），都严重依赖外部答案标签。作者希望避免这种标签依赖，探索在线策略蒸馏（OPD）的能力边界，并解决其缺乏轨迹级判别能力的局限。
AI.method: V-Zero框架：1）将OPD重新解释为无负例的停止梯度对齐，揭示了其缺乏轨迹级判别的问题；2）提出对比证据门控机制，将问题相关的区域裁剪作为正样本，与负视觉视图配对，用于评估学生采样的轨迹并控制密集token级蒸馏。
AI.result: 在多个视觉推理基准上，V-Zero一致提升了细粒度视觉推理性能，同时保持了良好的泛化能力。训练速度比监督微调快5倍以上，比强化学习基线快10倍以上。
AI.conclusion: V-Zero成功证明了无需答案标签即可有效进行细粒度视觉推理训练，通过对比证据门控弥补了OPD的轨迹级判别缺失，实现了高效且性能优越的视觉推理框架。

title: InvestPhilBench: A Multi-Layer Dynamic Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Model Procedural Reasoning in Expert Investment Philosophy
comment: 57 pages, 6 figures, 26 tables. Benchmark, data, and code released. v0.6 release; preliminary empirical study (de-confounded multi-model leaderboard forthcoming)
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as investment research assistants, yet no benchmark tests whether they can accurately reconstruct and apply the specific procedural decision frameworks of expert investors. We introduce InvestPhilBench, a multi-layer dynamic benchmark spanning eight cognitive tiers, from principle identification (L1) to novel framework extrapolation (L8). The v0.6 release comprises 118 primary-source-verified investment principle cards, 25 decision framework cards with explicit topology metadata, and 243 QA questions (197 dev / 46 held-out test). For reproducible scoring at scale we introduce the Benchmark Automated Scoring Pipeline (BASP) -- five algorithmic metrics (OGRS, KCCS, SAP@k, IVP, CKCA) -- the Failure Mode Detection Protocol (FMDP) with computable rules for six failure modes, and Gate Reconstruction Accuracy (GRA), a per-gate metric for questions with gold reasoning programs. In this release, InvestPhilBench is primarily a benchmark-and-methodology contribution. A four-model sanity wave on the 188-question development split shows a sharp provider-tier split (BASP 0.906 vs. 0.438); these mixed-judge numbers are confounded upper bounds. The central finding: the BASP composite saturates at the frontier (Claude L4 = 0.932) while GRA still exposes a procedural deficit (frontier L4 GRA approx. 0.77, L7 GRA 0.57-0.62) -- composite scoring rewards fluent prose and hides the procedural gap. v0.6 implements a unified judge and true model-in-the-loop retrieval/oracle conditions; the de-confounded multi-model leaderboard and full three-condition run are v1.0 deliverables. On a 100-item expert-annotated gold set the automated BASP composite tracks the human reference at Pearson r = 0.72 (MAE = 0.10), with attribution (SAP@3) the weakest sub-metric and the failure-mode detector running sensitive-but-over-flagging.

AI.tldr: 提出InvestPhilBench基准测试，评估LLM能否准确重建和应用投资决策框架。该基准涵盖8个认知层级，包含118张投资原则卡、25张决策框架卡和243个QA问题。引入BASP自动评分管道等指标。发现前沿模型BASP高分但GRA暴露出程序性缺陷——复合评分奖励流畅语言而隐藏了程序性差距。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试无法检验大语言模型是否能像专业投资者那样准确重建和应用投资决策程序性框架，存在评估空白。
AI.method: 构建多层级动态基准InvestPhilBench（8个认知层级L1-L8），包含投资原则卡、决策框架卡及QA问题。提出BASP自动评分管道（含5种算法指标）、FMDP故障模式检测协议和GRA门级重建准确率。
AI.result: 四模型测试显示供应商层级明显分岔（BASP 0.906 vs 0.438）。前沿模型BASP复合分数饱和（Claude L4=0.932），但GRA暴露程序性缺陷（L4约0.77，L7为0.57-0.62）。BASP复合分数与人工参考的Pearson r=0.72，SAP@3是最弱的子指标。
AI.conclusion: 复合评分奖励流畅语言输出，掩盖了程序性推理能力的不足；需要GRA等细粒度指标才能暴露模型在投资决策程序性框架上的真实缺陷。

title: AISPO: Enhancing Depth Reliability for Robotic Manipulation of Non-Lambertian Objects via Affine-Invariant Shape Prior
comment: Published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters. 8 pages. Accepted April 2026
summary: Reliable depth perception is critical for robotic manipulation, especially for non-Lambertian objects such as transparent or highly specular surfaces, where raw depth measurements are often corrupted or missing. These failures frequently propagate to motion planning, resulting in invalid grasp poses and execution errors. We propose AISPO, a depth completion framework that improves depth reliability for manipulation in challenging sensing conditions. AISPO combines multi-scale RGB-D feature fusion with an affine-invariant shape prior to enforce geometric consistency and mitigate catastrophic depth failures. Unlike methods that focus primarily on average depth accuracy, our approach emphasizes physical plausibility and structural integrity of the predicted depth maps. Extensive benchmark evaluations demonstrate competitive performance and strong generalization to unseen objects and novel scenes. Real-world grasping experiments further show that enhanced depth reliability significantly improves manipulation success rates, particularly for transparent objects where many existing methods fail to produce physically usable depth estimates.

AI.tldr: AISPO是一种深度补全框架，通过多尺度RGB-D特征融合与仿射不变形状先验，提升机器人操作中对非朗伯体（如透明、高反光物体）的深度感知可靠性，从而显著提高操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有深度传感器在非朗伯体表面（透明、高反光物体）上深度测量常出现缺失或错误，导致运动规划失败、抓取位姿无效。现有方法多关注平均深度精度，缺乏对深度图物理合理性和结构完整性的强调。
AI.method: 提出AISPO框架，结合多尺度RGB-D特征融合与仿射不变形状先验（affine-invariant shape prior），强制几何一致性，缓解深度估计中的灾难性失败。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上表现出竞争性性能，对未见物体和新场景有强泛化能力；真实机器人抓取实验表明，该方法显著提升操作成功率，尤其在透明物体场景中优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过提升深度图的物理合理性和结构完整性，AISPO有效改善了机器人在复杂光照条件下的操作可靠性，尤其适用于现有方法难以处理的透明物体抓取任务。

title: Efficient Remote Sensing Instance Segmentation with Linear-Time State Space Distilled Visual Foundation Models
comment: 17 pages, 11 figures, has been published in IEEE TGRS vol. 64, pp. 5625417-5625417, 2026, Art no. 5625417, doi: 10.1109/TGRS.2026.3696104
summary: The computational complexity of Transformers scales quadratically with the number of tokens, which significantly constrains the efficiency of vision models, particularly recent ViT-based foundation models in dense prediction tasks. Instance segmentation, a typical dense visual prediction task in the remote sensing field, faces similar challenges. In this paper, inspired by the recent advances of knowledge distillation in large language models, we introduce RS4D - a new remote sensing instance segmentation method with linear computational complexity, which addresses the inefficiency of long sequence modeling through distilled state space modeling (SSM). We propose an adaptive noise and masking knowledge distillation training method for pre-training lightweight SSM backbones, which effectively compresses knowledge from the vast self-attention space into a compact, dense linear state space. We also design a remote sensing image instance segmentation architecture based on this lightweight visual encoder, where we explore variants of three different backbones and two segmentation heads. Extensive experiments are conducted on multiple benchmark datasets, including SSDD, WHU, and NWPU. Compared to ViT-based approaches, our proposed SSM backbone achieves an 8x reduction in parameters and a 9x reduction in FLOPs while maintaining comparable or superior accuracy to both ViT- and CNN-based instance segmentation methods. The implementation codes have been publicly available at https://github.com/QinzheYang/RS4D.

AI.tldr: RS4D是一种基于蒸馏状态空间建模的遥感实例分割方法，通过知识蒸馏将Transformer的自注意力知识压缩到线性状态空间中，实现了线性计算复杂度，在参数减少8倍、FLOPs减少9倍的同时保持或超越ViT和CNN方法的精度。
AI.motivation: Transformer的计算复杂度随tokens数量呈二次增长，严重限制了基于ViT的遥感基础模型在密集预测任务（如实例分割）中的效率。
AI.method: 提出自适应噪声和掩码知识蒸馏训练方法用于预训练轻量级SSM骨干网络；基于该轻量级视觉编码器设计遥感实例分割架构，探索三种不同骨干网络和两种分割头变体。
AI.result: 在SSDD、WHU、NWPU等基准数据集上，相比ViT方法，参数减少8倍，FLOPs减少9倍，精度与ViT和CNN方法相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 通过蒸馏状态空间建模实现了线性复杂度的遥感实例分割，在显著降低计算开销的同时保持了高精度，为遥感领域长序列建模提供了高效解决方案。

title: Autodata: An agentic data scientist to create high quality synthetic data
summary: We introduce Autodata, a general method that enables AI agents to act as data scientists who build high quality training and evaluation data. We show how to train (meta-optimize) such a data scientist agent, so that it learns to create even stronger data. We describe the overall formulation, and a specific practical implementation, Agentic Self-Instruct. We conduct experiments on computer science research tasks, legal reasoning tasks and reasoning with mathematical objects, where we obtain improved results compared to classical synthetic dataset creation methods. Further, meta-optimizing the data scientist agent itself delivers an even larger performance uplift. Agentic data creation provides a way to convert increased inference compute into higher quality model training. Overall, we believe this direction has the potential to change the way we build AI data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Autodata方法，让AI代理充当数据科学家，自动构建高质量训练和评估数据，并通过元优化进一步提升数据质量，实验证明优于传统合成数据方法。
AI.motivation: 传统合成数据方法质量有限，需要一种能让AI自主构建更优训练数据的方法，以提升模型性能。
AI.method: 提出Autodata框架，让AI代理作为数据科学家；具体实现为Agentic Self-Instruct；通过元优化（meta-optimization）使数据科学代理学会创建更强的数据。
AI.result: 在计算机科学研究任务、法律推理任务和数学对象推理任务上，Autodata优于经典合成数据集创建方法；元优化后性能进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: Agentic数据创建能将增加的推理计算量转化为更高质量的模型训练，有望改变AI数据的构建方式。

title: GROVE: Grounded Pedestrian Simulation via Natural Language for Interactive Social Robot Navigation
summary: Pedestrian simulation is a critical component for training and deploying social robot navigation approaches, yet it remains a largely rigid system that repeatedly requires manual data generation to define even simple scenarios. We propose GROVE, a text-to-scenario pedestrian simulation framework that combines state-of-the-art approaches to produce realistic, socially challenging scenarios for social robot navigation. Our framework allows users to customize one of several common presets (emergency, queuing, normal) or even enter a fully independent prompt to generate a highly customizable pedestrian simulation. Multiple modules separately ensure the realism and soundness of long-horizon human behavior, medium-horizon pedestrian navigation, and short-horizon robot/social interactions. Each module is tuned by the prompt in a way that reflects the user intent across all aspects of pedestrian simulation. By dynamically selecting one of several state-of-the-art (SotA) approaches in our modules based on the scenario, we capture many situational nuances of pedestrian behavior in order to narrow the simulation-to-real (sim2real) gap. The human simulation is directly integrated into Isaac Sim, Gazebo, and RViz simulators for robot deployment in highly social environments. We validate our approach through qualitative comparison against existing pedestrian simulation baselines across scenarios of varying complexity in residential, hospital, and office environments. The result is a high-fidelity pedestrian simulation that challenges social robot navigation with complex, diverse, realistic human behaviors.

AI.tldr: GROVE是一个文本到场景的行人仿真框架，结合多种SOTA方法生成逼真、具有社交挑战性的场景，用于社交机器人导航训练与部署。
AI.motivation: 现有行人仿真系统过于僵化，需要手动生成数据来定义场景，缺乏灵活性和自动化能力。
AI.method: 提出GROVE框架，支持预设（紧急、排队、正常）或用户自定义文本提示；采用多模块分别处理长时程人类行为、中时程行人导航和短时程机器人/社交交互；根据场景动态选择SOTA方法缩小仿真到现实的差距；集成于Isaac Sim、Gazebo、RViz。
AI.result: 通过在不同复杂度场景（住宅、医院、办公室）中的定性比较，GROVE生成的行人仿真在逼真度和社交挑战性上优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: GROVE实现了高保真行人仿真，能够为社交机器人导航提供复杂、多样且真实的人类行为挑战。

title: State Space Models Meet Remote Sensing: A Survey
comment: 25 pages, 5 figures, has been published in SCIS SCIQ1 IF=8.1 https://doi.org/10.1007/s11432-025-4780-1
summary: State Space Models (SSMs), designed for long-range modeling, offer linear computational complexity and strong capabilities in capturing long-range dependencies. In the field of remote sensing, SSMs have gained popularity due to their effectiveness in addressing unique challenges such as dense visual predictions, multi-modal remote sensing data, and temporal remote sensing data, which have also yielded significant advancements in customized architectures. This paper presents a comprehensive review of SSM-based approaches in remote sensing, covering most of the relevant studies since SSMs were first introduced to the field. We offer a multi-dimensional analysis examining SSM applications in remote sensing tasks and discussing advancements in architecture design. This paper not only synthesizes the rapid progress in SSM-based research but also identifies key challenges and future opportunities. By providing a detailed perspective, this paper aims to serve as a foundational resource for remote sensing researchers, offering actionable insights to foster further advancements in this evolving domain. We will keep tracing related works at https://github.com/QinzheYang/Awesome-RS-State-Space-Model.

AI.tldr: 本文全面综述了状态空间模型（SSMs）在遥感领域的应用，涵盖多模态数据、密集视觉预测和时间序列遥感等任务，分析了架构设计进展、关键挑战及未来方向，并提供了持续更新的资源仓库。
AI.motivation: SSMs具有线性计算复杂度和强大的长程依赖建模能力，在遥感领域独特的挑战（如密集视觉预测、多模态和时序数据）中展现出巨大潜力，但缺乏系统性综述来总结该方向的快速发展。
AI.method: 采用多维度分析方法，系统梳理SSMs在遥感任务中的应用（密集预测、多模态、时间序列等），并讨论架构设计方面的演进，涵盖从SSMs引入遥感领域至今的主要研究成果。
AI.result: 全面总结了SSMs在遥感领域的应用现状和架构设计进展，识别出关键挑战与未来机遇，并建立了持续更新的开源资源仓库。
AI.conclusion: 本文为遥感研究者提供了SSM方向的系统性基础资源，通过详细视角和可操作见解推动该领域的进一步发展。

title: The Unfireable Safety Kernel: Execution-Time AI Alignment for AI Agents and Other Escapable AI Systems
summary:
AI agents are granted access to tools, APIs, and other infrastructure, making them active principals in those systems. The dominant approach places controls inside the agent's own runtime: system prompts, output filters, and guardrail libraries. Any control in the agent's address space is reachable by inputs that influence it; this generalizes to any AI system with sufficient reach into its own runtime, a class we term escapable AI systems.
  We identify four properties that an authorization mechanism must satisfy for architectural control rather than for cooperative requests: process separation, pre-action enforcement on a structurally only path, fail-closed at both the request and system levels, and externalized signed evidence verifiable outside the controlled system's trust boundary. We position this layer as execution-time AI alignment, complementing training-time alignment (RLHF, Constitutional AI) and inference-time alignment.
  We present the Unfireable Safety Kernel, a Rust reference implementation realizing all four. Its fail-closed invariant is machine-checked at two levels: an SMT theorem (Z3) and an exhaustive bounded-model-checking proof of the production decision function (Kani, 4/4 harnesses). A Python-to-Rust migration was gated on byte-equivalence (1000/1000 fixtures; 17/17 adversarial classes). We evaluate the kernel governing a live, escapable AI system, a deterministic, self-improving world model, against an escape-seeking adversary driving its real self-modification seam: across 1,000 self-modifications, all 704 attempts on the safety-critical core are refused, with no escape; a further 300, under the operator kill switch, are also refused. A separate campaign of 6,240 authorization round-trips had no successful bypass. Against 3 contemporary systems claiming the agent control plane, the agent invokes control; here, it lacks that choice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对可逃逸AI系统（AI agents）的架构级授权控制机制——Unfireable Safety Kernel，通过进程隔离、唯一路径前置执行、双重失效关闭和外部化签名验证四个核心属性，在运行时实现AI对齐。该机制在Rust中实现，并通过SMT定理证明和边界模型检查验证了其安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI agent的安全控制（系统提示、输出过滤、护栏库）都放在agent自身的运行时中，任何在其地址空间内的控制都可被输入影响而绕过，这类系统被称为"可逃逸AI系统"。因此需要一个架构级的、不可绕过的授权机制。
AI.method: 提出Unfireable Safety Kernel，满足四个属性：1）进程隔离；2）在结构上的唯一路径执行前置动作；3）在请求和系统级别双重失效关闭；4）外部化签名证据，可在受控系统信任边界外验证。在Rust中实现，通过Z3 SMT定理证明和Kani边界模型检查（4/4 harnesses）验证不变性，Python到Rust迁移需通过字节级等价测试（1000/1000 fixtures, 17/17 adversarial classes）。
AI.result: 在确定性自改进世界模型上测试：1000次自修改中，704次对安全核心的攻击被拒绝，无逃逸；额外300次在操作员终止开关下也被拒绝。6240次授权往返测试中无成功绕过。与3个声称拥有agent控制平面的当代系统对比，本系统的agent无法自主调用控制。
AI.conclusion: 架构级执行时对齐（execution-time AI alignment）是训练时对齐和推理时对齐的重要补充。Unfireable Safety Kernel证明了通过形式化验证的、进程隔离的授权机制可以有效防御可逃逸AI系统的安全威胁。

title: ASSCG: Just-Right Gating over Chattering for Fast-Slow LLM Planning in Autonomous Driving
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can improve autonomous driving planning but are costly to query online, and existing fast-slow planners often rely on hand-designed triggering rules that either over-call the slow system or call it at the wrong times. We formulate slow-system invocation as a resource-aware sequential decision problem and propose the Adaptive Slow-System Control Gate (ASSCG), which makes frame-level Query/Cache/Drop decisions to refresh, reuse, or suppress slow guidance. ASSCG uses an RWKV backbone for efficient long-horizon gating and is trained with supervised fine-tuning followed by GRPO-style compute-aware reinforcement fine-tuning. We apply ASSCG to two different fast-slow architectures: (i) AsyncDriver on nuPlan Hard20 closed-loop evaluation, where ASSCG improves score to 67.28 (+2.28) while reducing average end-to-end inference latency by 60%; and (ii) a RecogDrive-based dual system that we build by replacing its original VLM-2B module with a lightweight ViT-based fast planner and adding an LLM slow planner, evaluated on NAVSIM, where ASSCG achieves 91.4 PDMS (+0.6) and increases average speed by 25%. The project page, including video visualizations and additional results, is available at https://williamxuanyu.github.io/asscg/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASSCG（自适应慢系统控制门），通过强化学习优化的RWKV门控机制，在自动驾驶快慢双系统中动态决策查询/缓存/丢弃LLM慢规划结果，在nuPlan和NAVSIM上分别提升2.28分成绩+60%延迟降低和0.6 PDMS+25%速度提升。
AI.motivation: LLM能提升自动驾驶规划效果，但在线查询成本高；现有快慢规划器依赖手工设计的触发规则，要么过度调用慢系统，要么在错误时机调用，缺乏资源感知的智能调度。
AI.method: 将慢系统调用建模为资源感知的序列决策问题，提出ASSCG门控机制，支持帧级别的Query/Cache/Drop三种决策；采用RWKV骨干网络进行高效长程门控，先监督微调后使用GRPO风格的计算感知强化微调。
AI.result: 在AsyncDriver+nuPlan上分数提升2.28（达67.28），端到端推理延迟降低60%；在RecogDrive+NAVSIM上PDMS提升0.6（达91.4），平均速度提升25%。
AI.conclusion: ASSCG有效解决了快慢规划器中慢系统调用时机和频率的优化问题，通过学习型门控替代手工规则，在保持规划性能的同时显著降低计算成本。

title: Invoice Haystack: Benchmarking Document Retrieval and Visual Question Answering Under Strong Visual Homogeneity
summary: Vision Language Models have achieved near-human performance on single-document Visual Question Answering, yet their effectiveness degrades significantly when retrieving information from large collections of visually homogeneous documents. Existing multi-document benchmarks aggregate diverse document types, creating artificial separation in embedding space that does not reflect enterprise document repositories where thousands of records share identical visual templates. We identify this as embedding collapse and introduce Invoice Haystack, a benchmark with 1,500 anonymized invoice images paired with 200 discriminative question-answer pairs, specifically designed to stress-test retrieval under strong visual homogeneity. Invoice Haystack exhibits a mean pairwise cosine similarity of 0.73, compared to 0.38 (DocHaystack) and 0.31 (InfoHaystack) in existing benchmarks, posing a fundamentally more challenging retrieval problem. Addressing the identified challenge, we propose VL-RAG, a hybrid retrieval-augmented generation framework that jointly leverages text and visual embeddings to harness the complementary strengths of both modalities, followed by a VLM-based verification filter for precise document identification. VL-RAG achieves 60.0\% Recall@1 on Invoice Haystack-500, outperforming existing state-of-the-art method by up to an absolute 13.5 percentage points. It further improves retrieval considerably on DocHaystack-1000 (77.1\% vs.\ 75.2\%) and InfoHaystack-1000 (84.5\% vs.\ 80.0\%), establishing the proposed dual-stream fusion as a consistently superior retrieval strategy across both homogeneous and heterogeneous document collections.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Invoice Haystack基准（1500张发票，视觉高度同质）和VL-RAG混合检索框架，解决VLM在视觉同质文档集合中的"嵌入坍塌"问题，VL-RAG在Recall@1上超越现有方法13.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在单文档VQA上表现接近人类，但在视觉高度同质的大规模文档集合中检索能力显著下降。现有多文档基准包含多样文档类型，在嵌入空间中形成人为区分，无法反映企业文档库中成千上万记录共享相同视觉模板的现实场景。作者将此问题定义为"嵌入坍塌"。
AI.method: 1) 构建Invoice Haystack基准：1500张匿名发票+200个判别性问答对，平均余弦相似度0.73（远超现有基准的0.38/0.31）；2) 提出VL-RAG混合检索增强生成框架：联合利用文本和视觉嵌入的双流融合，再通过VLM验证过滤器进行精确文档识别。
AI.result: VL-RAG在Invoice Haystack-500上Recall@1达60.0%，比SOTA高13.5个百分点；在DocHaystack-1000达77.1%（vs 75.2%），InfoHaystack-1000达84.5%（vs 80.0%），一致优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 双流融合策略是跨同质和异质文档集合的一致优越检索策略，VL-RAG有效缓解了视觉同质文档的嵌入坍塌问题。

title: One Body, Two Minds: Variable Autonomy Approach for a Co-embodied Robotic Hand
summary:
Assistive robotic systems face a fundamental trade-off: fully autonomous systems lack user agency, while fully user-controlled systems demand continuous cognitive effort. Existing shared autonomy approaches blend human and robot commands but are mostly deployed in separate physical bodies. We introduce co-embodiment with variable autonomy, where human and robot share a single physical body and operate at different autonomy levels across task phases, from mutual autonomy during object search and grasping to human-dominant control during actuation.
  We present a co-embodied, wearable robotic hand that has its own ``mind'' and operates with variable autonomy levels. A learning-from-demonstration visuomotor diffusion policy enables autonomous grasping when the user positions the hand near known objects. Once grasped, the system signals completion and the human can actuate the grasped tool (drill, spray bottle, infrared thermometer, lighter, and ice-cream scoop) via hands-free head gestures. The human retains veto authority at all times through a release gesture that returns the system to the initial phase. Unlike blended autonomy, where control is continuously negotiated, our co-embodied approach consists of variable autonomy from full human control to full independent actions while maintaining physical coupling, realizing a one body, two minds paradigm.
  In a user study with 44 participants performing five bimanual tasks, users rapidly adapted to this ``two minds'' paradigm: completion times improved by 23.3% across trials ($p < 0.001$, Cohen's $d = 0.94$), the best-performing policy variant reached a 93.6% task success rate, and acceptance ratings were high (5.70/7 overall impression, 5.52/7 daily use willingness). This work establishes co-embodiment with variable autonomy as a viable approach for assistive robotics, enabling human-robot collaboration through co-embodiment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种共体变自主性（co-embodiment with variable autonomy）的可穿戴机器人手，让人类和机器人共享同一物理身体，在不同任务阶段（如自主抓取与人类控制）切换自主层级，实现"一个身体，两个大脑"的协作范式。用户研究（N=44）显示任务完成时间提升23.3%，成功率高达93.6%，接受度良好。
AI.motivation: 现有辅助机器人面临两难：全自主系统剥夺用户主动性，而全用户控制则需要持续的认知努力。已有共享自主方法虽混合人类与机器人指令，但大多部署在分离的物理身体中，缺乏真正的物理耦合。
AI.method: 设计了一款共体可穿戴机器人手，采用从示教学习（Learning from Demonstration）的视觉运动扩散策略（Visuomotor Diffusion Policy）实现自主抓取；通过头部手势实现人类控制；用户可通过释放手势（Release Gesture）保留否决权。实现了从完全人类控制到完全自主行动的变自主性。
AI.result: 44名参与者完成5项双手任务，任务完成时间提升23.3%（p<0.001, Cohen's d=0.94），最佳策略变体任务成功率达93.6%，总体印象评分5.70/7，日常使用意愿5.52/7。
AI.conclusion: 共体变自主性作为一种可行的辅助机器人范式，通过物理共体实现了人类与机器人之间的有效协作，平衡了自主性与用户控制权。

title: Follow Your Track: Precise Skeleton Animation Controlled by 3D Trajectories
summary: 4D generation aims to animate 3D objects with realistic motion, holding great promise for applications. Existing methods typically decouple 3D asset generation from motion synthesis: acquire a 3D asset, prepare a structural representation like mesh and Gaussians, and synthesize motion from text or video control signals. However, dense mesh and Gaussian representations incur high computational costs and are prone to temporal artifacts, limiting animation quality and duration to only short clips. Meanwhile, text lacks fine-grained spatial and temporal details such as timing and coordination, while video entangles motion with appearance and background. Together, these limitations result in 4D animations that suffer from poor temporal consistency, wrong identification, and limited controllability. We address these issues with \texttt{ACT}, a trajectory-conditioned framework for topology-general skeletal animation. ACT uses skeletons as a compact structured and compute-efficient representation and 3D point trajectories from monocular video as explicit motion guidance which provide detailed motion patterns without appearance entanglement. At the core of ACT is a Routed Trajectory Injector, which achieves accurate and robust trajectory-to-joint transfer through three complementary designs: prior-guided hard routing establishes precise skeleton-to-mesh correspondences, global routing enables holistic joint-track interaction for full-body motion awareness, and local windowed cross-attention enforces fine-grained temporal alignment, improving micro-timing and reducing motion misalignment across varying motion rates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \texttt{ACT} significantly outperforms existing methods in fidelity and temporal consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACT框架，利用骨骼作为紧凑表示，结合3D点轨迹进行显式运动引导，通过路由轨迹注入器实现准确的轨迹到关节映射，在4D生成中显著提升了保真度和时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有4D生成方法依赖稠密网格或高斯表示，计算成本高且易产生时间伪影，文本和视频控制信号分别缺乏时空细节或与外观纠缠，导致时间一致性差、身份错误和可控性有限。
AI.method: 提出ACT框架，采用骨骼作为拓扑通用的紧凑表示，利用单目视频的3D点轨迹作为显式运动引导（解耦外观），核心是Routed Trajectory Injector，包含三种机制：先验引导硬路由（精确骨骼-网格对应）、全局路由（全身运动感知）和局部窗口交叉注意力（细粒度时间对齐）。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ACT在保真度和时间一致性上显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: ACT通过骨骼表示和轨迹引导，有效解决了4D生成中的时间一致性、身份错误和可控性问题，为高质量4D动画生成提供了新范式。

title: WOLF-VLA: Whole-Body Humanoid Optimal Locomotion Framework for Vision-Language-Action Learning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently demonstrated strong generalization in robotic manipulation, yet their applicability to whole-body, contact-rich humanoid locomotion remains severely underexplored due to data scarcity, the absence of dynamically consistent demonstrations, and the difficulty of encoding optimality and safety in learning-based pipelines. This work introduces a unified framework WOLF-VLA that integrates whole-body optimal-control (OC) motion synthesis with large-scale multi-modal dataset to train VLAs capable of generating humanoid locomotion policies directly from natural-language instructions. We construct a comprehensive dataset of dynamically feasible humanoid trajectories across six locomotion-related task families, each parameterized by environmental variations, object colors, placements, and visual distractors. We train a VLA model using the collected joint trajectories, ego-centric visual observations and natural language instruction, yielding a policy that exhibits strong reasoning and robustness to initial-condition variability, and competitive performance across several tasks and environment settings. A systematic ablation study demonstrates the impact of each modality on the model performance. The full dataset, model checkpoints, and benchmarking simulation suite will be openly released, establishing a reproducible dynamically consistent benchmark for whole-body humanoid locomotion rich VLA control and enabling future research in scalable transfer of instruction-driven locomotion policies.

AI.tldr: 提出WOLF-VLA框架，融合全身最优控制运动合成与大规模多模态数据集，训练VLA模型直接从自然语言指令生成仿人机器人全身运动策略，解决数据稀缺和动态一致性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在机器人操作任务中表现优异，但尚未有效应用于仿人机器人全身接触丰富的运动控制，主要面临数据稀缺、缺乏动态一致的运动演示、以及难以将最优性和安全性编码到学习管道中三大挑战。
AI.method: 构建包含六类运动任务的动态可行仿人轨迹数据集，参数化环境变化、物体颜色、位置及视觉干扰；使用联合轨迹、自我中心视觉观察和自然语言指令训练VLA模型。
AI.result: 训练出的策略展现出强大的推理能力和对初始条件变化的鲁棒性，在多个任务和环境设置中表现具有竞争力；消融研究验证了各模态对模型性能的影响。
AI.conclusion: WOLF-VLA为全身仿人运动控制的VLA方法建立了可复现的动态一致基准，数据集、模型和仿真套件将开源，推动指令驱动运动策略的可扩展迁移研究。

title: Hypergraph Normal World Models for Logical Visual Anomaly Detection
summary: Visual anomaly detection is often deployed with only normal training images. Most one-class detectors map test patches or features to a normal reference distribution. This works well for local structural defects. Logical anomalies are different. Each visible part may look normal, while the whole image violates a normal count, co-occurrence, or spatial relation. This paper studies whether a model can learn such a category-specific normal world from nominal images alone. We propose the Hypergraph Normal World Model, a normal-only detector that distills frozen DINOv2 patch tokens into patch, relation, and hypergraph statistics. It builds spatial hyperedges over token groups. It then scores each test image with an information quotient that separates local, relational, hyperedge, and hyperedge-relation evidence. On the available MVTec LOCO breakfast-box validation data, the full hypergraph model improves logical anomaly AUROC from 0.8434 for DINOv2 patch-kNN to 0.9279. It also improves over the non-hypergraph variant, from 0.9013 to 0.9279. Few-shot experiments show that the model remains effective with very limited normal images. We also test whether the score reflects normal-world knowledge rather than a shallow mapping. t-SNE separates logical anomalies in the learned energy space. Relation counterfactuals increase the information quotient by 83.13 on average. Random hypergraphs reduce logical AUROC, and hyperedge attribution is much larger on logical anomalies. Qualitative examples show that high scores are driven by relation-bearing terms. These results suggest that logical visual anomaly detection should model normal relations, not only normal local patches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出超图常态世界模型（Hypergraph Normal World Model），利用DINOv2令牌构建超图结构来建模正常图像中的局部、关系与超图统计量，从而检测逻辑异常。在MVTec LOCO数据集上，逻辑异常AUROC从0.8434提升至0.9279，并验证了建模正常关系对逻辑异常检测的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现有单类异常检测方法主要针对局部结构缺陷，难以处理逻辑异常——每个局部看似正常，但整体违反数量、共现或空间关系。本文旨在探索能否仅从正常图像中学习类别特定的"常态世界"，以检测逻辑异常。
AI.method: 基于冻结的DINOv2补丁令牌，构建超图常态世界模型：将令牌分组形成空间超边，提取局部、关系、超边和超边关系四类统计量；通过信息商（information quotient）对测试图像进行评分，分离不同层级的证据。
AI.result: 在MVTec LOCO早餐盒验证集上，逻辑异常AUROC从DINOv2 patch-kNN的0.8434提升至0.9279；相比无超图变体（0.9013）也有提升。少样本实验仍有效。t-SNE能分离逻辑异常，关系反事实使信息商平均提升83.13，随机超图降低AUROC，超边归因在逻辑异常上更大。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑视觉异常检测不仅应建模正常局部补丁，更应建模正常关系。超图结构能有效捕捉逻辑异常所需的全局关系信息。

title: 1000 Rallies: An Event-Camera Dataset and Real-Time Learned Ball-State Estimation for Robotic Table Tennis
summary: Robotic table tennis has emerged as a compelling benchmark for real-time robotic perception due to its fast ball dynamics and stringent timing requirements. Accurate, high-frequency, and low-latency ball state estimation is critical for reliable trajectory prediction and timely control. Traditional frame-based cameras face an inherent trade-off: low frame rates leave temporal blind spots that miss fast-moving objects and high frame rates raise data and computational cost. Event cameras instead offer microsecond temporal resolution and, under sufficient illumination, remain largely free of motion blur even at high ball speeds. However, the community lacks large-scale datasets to develop and benchmark event-based perception in realistic sports scenarios. We address this gap by introducing the first large-scale event-camera dataset for table tennis, comprising over 1000 rallies from a diverse group of players ranging from amateurs to elite-level athletes. Each recording captures the event stream alongside 14 synchronized high-speed frame-based cameras at 200 FPS, which we use to produce 1 kHz pseudo ground-truth labels for ball position, velocity, and spin. Building on this dataset, we train a convolutional neural network robust to background player motion that jointly estimates the ball's position and velocity in the image-plane from events. Treating the predicted velocity as an additional measurement in the Kalman filter reduces bounce-point prediction error by 36% relative to a position-only baseline. Finally, we close the perception-action loop by integrating the event-based system with a Stäubli robotic arm, enabling the first real-time human-robot table tennis rallies driven by event-based perception.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出大规模乒乓球事件相机数据集，包含超1000回合、14台同步高速相机与事件流，训练了联合估计球位置与速度的CNN，结合卡尔曼滤波将弹跳点预测误差降低36%，并成功实现基于事件感知的实时人机对打。
AI.motivation: 传统帧相机在高速乒乓球场景下存在帧率与计算成本的矛盾，事件相机虽有微秒级时间分辨率优势，但缺乏大规模真实场景数据集来支撑事件感知的研发与评测。
AI.method: 构建大规模事件相机乒乓球数据集（1000+回合，14台200FPS高速相机同步记录），通过200FPS帧插值生成1kHz伪真值标签；训练CNN联合估计图像平面中的球位置与速度；将预测速度作为额外测量值输入卡尔曼滤波器；最后集成Stäubli机械臂实现闭环控制。
AI.result: 联合估计球速作为卡尔曼滤波附加测量量，相比仅用位置的基线，弹跳点预测误差降低36%。成功实现首个人机实时乒乓球对打系统。
AI.conclusion: 事件相机结合CNN与卡尔曼滤波可显著提升高速球类运动的预测精度，为实时机器人感知提供了高效新范式，且开源数据集填补了领域空白。

title: Beyond Visual Forensics: Auditing Multimodal Robustness for Synthetic Medical Image Detection
summary: With the rapid adoption of generative AI, synthetic medical images pose growing risks, including diagnostic deception and insurance fraud. Although prior work has explored vision-language model (VLM)-based synthetic image detection, these evaluations typically consider images in isolation. In clinical practice, however, images are interpreted alongside structured records and metadata, and VLMs are increasingly deployed under joint image-record inputs. We uncover a previously underexamined multimodal vulnerability: when given both modalities, VLMs may overweight record context in authenticity judgments, such that the same image receives different predictions solely due to changes in its accompanying text. This raises concerns about robustness in real-world deployment. To systematically characterize this effect, we reformulate synthetic medical image detection as an audit of multimodal robustness at the image-record interface and introduce a paired benchmark that holds the image fixed while swapping controlled metadata variants. Across multiple imaging modalities, we evaluate diverse open-weight and frontier API VLMs and quantify how metadata alone shifts authenticity predictions. Our benchmark provides a standardized tool for assessing and improving multimodal robustness beyond image-only settings. The code is available at https://github.com/chiuhaohao/Beyond-Visual-Forensics.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了一个被忽视的多模态漏洞：在合成医学图像检测中，视觉语言模型（VLM）会过度依赖文本元数据来判断图像真实性，导致同一张图像因伴随文本不同而产生不同的预测结果。作者为此构建了一个配对基准测试，系统评估了多种VLM在多模态输入下的鲁棒性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有合成医学图像检测研究通常孤立评估图像，但临床实践中图像与结构化记录、元数据共同呈现，VLM也越来越多地在图文联合输入场景下部署。作者发现VLM存在过度依赖文本上下文的漏洞，即同一图像因文本变化而得到不同真实性预测，这威胁到实际部署的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 将合成医学图像检测重新定义为图像-记录界面的多模态鲁棒性审计问题；构建配对基准测试，保持图像固定，仅交换受控的元数据变体；在多种成像模态下评估多种开源和前沿API VLM，量化元数据单独对真实性预测的偏移程度。
AI.result: 发现VLM在多模态输入下会过度加权记录上下文，导致同一图像因文本变化而产生不同的真实性预测结果，揭示了多模态脆弱性的存在。
AI.conclusion: 该基准测试为评估和改进超越纯图像设置的多模态鲁棒性提供了标准化工具，代码已开源。

title: Event-Adaptive Motion Planning with Distilled Vision-Language Model in Safety-Critical Situations
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Accepted by IROS 2026
summary: Robot navigation in safety-critical scenarios faces significant challenges from unforeseen semantic events, where collisions arise primarily from the unpredictable behaviors of dynamic agents rather than unseen objects. While large vision-language models (VLMs) offer remarkable capabilities in commonsense reasoning, frequently invoking them within the continuous control loop introduces severe computational latency, fundamentally destabilizing physical execution. To address these challenges, we propose event-adaptive motion planning (EAMP), an efficient framework for VLM-based robot navigation. Specifically, a prompt-configurable semantic event trigger (PC-SET) selectively activates semantic intervention by continuously monitoring short temporal clips for behavioral anomalies. Upon triggering, an event-triggered distilled SemNav-VLM, fine-tuned via physically verified semantic distillation, maps detected anomalies into discrete strategy-level decisions. Subsequently, a semantic model predictive control (SMPC) module translates these strategies into dynamic reconfigurations of optimization objectives and geometric references. Extensive experiments in safety-critical logistics scenarios demonstrate that EAMP effectively aligns high-level reasoning with low-level control, significantly improving dynamic safety margins over existing baselines while preserving real-time efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出事件自适应运动规划（EAMP），一种基于VLM的高效机器人导航框架。通过可配置语义事件触发器（PC-SET）选择性激活干预，利用蒸馏后的SemNav-VLM进行策略级决策，并由语义模型预测控制（SMPC）将策略转化为底层控制调整，在安全关键物流场景中显著提升动态安全裕度并保持实时性。
AI.motivation: 机器人导航面临动态智能体行为不可预测导致的安全问题；大视觉语言模型虽有常识推理能力但频繁调用会引发严重计算延迟，影响物理执行稳定性。
AI.method: 1) 可配置语义事件触发器（PC-SET）：持续监测短时域片段中的行为异常，选择性激活语义干预；2) 事件触发蒸馏SemNav-VLM：通过物理验证的语义蒸馏微调，将检测到的异常映射为离散策略级决策；3) 语义模型预测控制（SMPC）：将策略转化为优化目标和几何参考的动态重构。
AI.result: 在安全关键物流场景中，EAMP有效对齐高层推理与底层控制，相比现有基线显著提升动态安全裕度，同时保持实时效率。
AI.conclusion: EAMP通过事件驱动的选择性VLM调用机制，解决了计算效率与语义推理能力之间的权衡问题，证明了将大模型用于实时机器人导航的可行方案。

title: Transferable Attack against Face Swapping in an Extended Space
summary: Although deep Face Swapping (FS) models may benefit the entertainment industry, they pose severe threats to privacy and security. Existing protections, including deepfake detection and adversarial perturbation, are either passive responses or ineffective to unseen subject-agnostic FS models. In this paper, we propose a transferable attack against subject-agnostic FS models named Additive Identity attack based on a Relighting function (AIR). AIR leverages reillumination and additive perturbations to mislead the identity extraction modules in subject-agnostic FS models. By using these two types of perturbations simultaneously, the attack space is extended such that stronger but more visually natural adversarial examples can be identified. To further enhance the visual quality while preserving the effectiveness of the attack, an adaptive translation-invariant operation and an illumination control scheme are designed for AIR. Unlike other methods, AIR does not require a surrogate FS model to achieve high transferability. In addition, a mathematical proof is given for the extension of the attack space. Extensive experiments using 1000 image pairs across various state-of-the-art subject-agnostic FS models, including GAN and diffusion-based FS models, show that AIR surpasses all existing attacks in terms of both attack success rate and image quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对主体无关换脸模型的可迁移攻击方法AIR，通过重光照和加性扰动同时攻击身份提取模块，在无需替代模型的情况下实现了高成功率和高质量攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有针对换脸模型的防御方法（如深度伪造检测、对抗扰动）要么是被动响应，要么对未见的主体无关换脸模型无效，亟需一种主动且可迁移的攻击方法。
AI.method: 提出基于重光照函数的加性身份攻击（AIR），同时使用重光照扰动和加性扰动来欺骗身份提取模块；设计自适应平移不变操作和光照控制方案以提升视觉质量；理论上证明了攻击空间的扩展性。
AI.result: 在1000对图像上，针对包括GAN和扩散模型在内的多种SOTA主体无关换脸模型进行实验，AIR在攻击成功率和图像质量上均超越现有所有攻击方法。
AI.conclusion: AIR无需替代模型即可实现高迁移性攻击，为换脸模型的主动防御提供了新思路。

title: Calousel: Extrinsic Calibration of Non-overlapping Multi-camera Systems from Pure Rotation
summary: Extrinsic calibration of multi-camera systems with non-overlapping FOVs has been a challenging problem in the robotics literature. Conventional target-based methods impose substantial target setup overhead, either deploying large calibration targets or requiring pre-measured multi-target poses. Motion-based approaches instead suffer from drift error, scale ambiguity, and motion degeneracy. Securing both accuracy and usability, we propose a novel calibration method that leverages pure rotational motion, requiring only a single static calibration board. The key idea is to make all cameras sequentially observe the same target under a shared geometric reference, even without overlapping views. To integrate these time-separated observations, we formulate the problem using a latent turntable frame and a 3D error on SE(3) within a global optimization framework. We validate the proposed method on both a controlled camera rig and a full-scale vehicle platform with heterogeneous cameras, and analyze robustness under non-ideal turntable motion. Extensive experiments show that our approach maintains competitive accuracy without specialized precision hardware, proving its strong suitability for realistic on-site deployments. Our code is publicly available here.

AI.tldr: 提出一种利用纯旋转运动实现多相机系统（无重叠视场）外参标定的方法，仅需单个静态标定板，结合隐式转台坐标系与SE(3)全局优化，兼顾精度与易用性。
AI.motivation: 现有无重叠视场多相机标定方法存在两难：基于标定板的方法需要大型标定板或预置多板位姿，部署繁琐；基于运动的方法易受漂移、尺度模糊和运动退化影响。因此需要一种既精确又实用的标定方案。
AI.method: 利用纯旋转运动，让所有相机在时间上依次观测同一静态标定板，通过共享的隐式转台坐标系建立几何关联，将问题建模为SE(3)上的3D误差并在全局优化框架中求解。
AI.result: 在受控相机台架和全尺寸异构相机车辆平台上均验证了有效性，分析了非理想转台运动下的鲁棒性，精度与现有方法相当，无需精密专用硬件。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保持竞争精度的同时显著降低了硬件和部署要求，适合实际现场标定场景，并已开源代码。

title: Anatomically-conditioned Latent Diffusion Model for Data-Efficient Few-Shot Cross-Domain 3D Glioma MRI Synthesis
summary: Accurate classification of diffuse gliomas is often hindered by domain shifts across centers and a lack of large, annotated datasets. We propose the Anatomically-conditioned Latent Diffusion Model (ALDM), a novel framework for data-efficient, few-shot 3D volumetric MRI synthesis. ALDM utilizes a two-stage approach: a 3D variational autoencoder learns anatomical priors from a data-rich source domain, while a conditional latent diffusion model, guided by tumor masks via a ControlNet, generates structurally coherent volumes for a data-scarce target domain. Evaluated in an extreme few-shot setting with only 16 target images, ALDM outperformed GAN and hybrid baselines, achieving a superior Frechet Inception Distance (FID) of 85.40 and a downstream classification AUC of 0.987. Qualitative results confirm that the model preserves sharp pathology boundaries and cross-modal consistency, with visual fidelity improving progressively during training. By capturing essential diagnostic features, ALDM provides a robust tool for clinical data augmentation in low-resource settings. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Analytics-Everywhere-Lab/anatomically-conditioned-LDM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ALDM，一种用于少样本3D MRI合成的框架，通过两阶段方法（3D VAE + 条件潜在扩散模型）在仅有16张目标图像的情况下生成结构连贯的脑肿瘤体积，在FID和分类AUC指标上优于GAN基线。
AI.motivation: 弥散胶质瘤的准确分类常因跨中心域偏移和缺乏大规模标注数据集而受阻，亟需一种数据高效且能处理域差异的医学图像合成方法。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段用3D变分自编码器从数据丰富的源域学习解剖先验；第二阶段用条件潜在扩散模型，通过ControlNet以肿瘤掩膜为条件，在数据稀缺的目标域生成结构连贯的3D体积。
AI.result: 在仅16张目标图像的极限少样本设置下，ALDM的FID达85.40，下游分类AUC达0.987，均优于GAN和混合基线。病理边界清晰、跨模态一致性好。
AI.conclusion: ALDM通过捕获关键诊断特征，为低资源环境下的临床数据增强提供了鲁棒工具，代码已开源。

title: Learning to Adapt: Reptile-D-Learning for Robust and Efficient Control Under Parametric Uncertainty
summary: Learning-based Lyapunov Control (LLC) provides formal stability guarantees for nonlinear systems, but its validity relies heavily on accurate system models. Parameter variations and uncertainties may invalidate stability constraints, leading to costly retraining. Although D-learning can estimate Lyapunov derivatives without relying on explicit dynamics models, it remains limited by single-task dynamics and degrades under large parameter shifts. We propose Reptile-D-learning, a framework that leverages the Reptile meta-learning algorithm to capture shared dynamical structures across systems with different parameters, thereby learning a generalizable Lyapunov network initialization and a high-performance controller. Experiments on multiple nonlinear control systems demonstrate that Reptile-D-learning significantly improves both generalization and rapid adaptation to unseen parameter configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出Reptile-D-learning框架，利用元学习算法Reptile学习可泛化的Lyapunov网络初始化和高性能控制器，解决基于学习的Lyapunov控制因参数变化导致需要重训练的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的Lyapunov控制（LLC）依赖精确系统模型，参数变化和不确定性会使稳定性约束失效，导致昂贵的重训练；D-learning虽不依赖显式动力学模型，但受限于单任务动力学，在大参数偏移下性能退化。
AI.method: 提出Reptile-D-learning框架，利用Reptile元学习算法捕捉不同参数系统间的共享动力学结构，学习可泛化的Lyapunov网络初始化和高性能控制器。
AI.result: 在多个非线性控制系统上的实验表明，Reptile-D-learning在泛化能力和对未见参数配置的快速自适应方面均显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 元学习能够有效提升基于学习的Lyapunov控制方法在参数变化下的泛化性和适应性，减少重训练成本。

title: Teach-to-Reason: Competition-Guided Reasoning with a Self-Improving Teacher
summary: Chest X-ray visual question answering (CXR VQA) requires models not only to predict correct answers, but also to produce reliable medical reasoning. However, existing reinforcement-learning-based training typically relies on answer-level rewards, which are often too coarse to improve chain-of-thought (CoT) quality and can become ineffective when group-level advantages collapse to zero. We propose \textbf{Teach-to-Reason (T2R)}, a framework that introduces comparison-based supervision into CoT optimization through a self-improving \emph{Teacher} and a competition-guided \emph{Reasoner}. As the Teacher is iteratively strengthened via self-competition, the Reasoner is optimized against progressively stronger Teacher-generated references. We further introduce a case-wise reward design that preserves the original reward-induced positive/negative partition when it is informative, and restores supervision from competition scores when the original reward signal degenerates. Experiments on multiple CXR open-ended VQA benchmarks show that T2R consistently outperforms strong baselines, indicating that comparison-based supervision, when integrated in a controlled and principled manner, provides a more effective training signal for reasoning optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Teach-to-Reason (T2R)框架，通过比较监督信号和自改进教师模型来优化胸部X光视觉问答中的链式推理过程，克服了传统强化学习中答案级奖励过于粗糙的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于强化学习的训练通常使用答案级奖励，但这种奖励过于粗糙，难以有效提升链式推理质量。当群体优势趋近于零时，奖励信号甚至会失效。
AI.method: T2R框架包含一个自改进的Teacher和一个竞争引导的Reasoner。Teacher通过自我竞争逐步强化，Reasoner则针对逐步增强的Teacher生成参考进行优化。同时设计了案例级奖励机制：在原始奖励信号有效时保留正负分区，在退化时通过竞争分数恢复监督信号。
AI.result: 在多个胸部X光开放VQA基准上，T2R一致优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 以受控且原则性的方式整合比较监督，能够为推理优化提供更有效的训练信号。

title: Power-Budgeted Underwater Vehicle Control via Constrained Reinforcement Learning
summary: Underwater vehicles operate from a fixed onboard energy budget that propulsion rapidly depletes, so a controller that completes its task while drawing less thruster power directly extends mission range and endurance. Reinforcement learning yields capable model-free controllers for station-keeping and trajectory tracking, but optimizing task accuracy alone drives the policy toward oscillatory, energy-wasting actuation. The established remedy subtracts an energy penalty from the reward, yet this sets the task-power trade-off through a single weight with no physical units: a target power level cannot be specified, the weight must be re-tuned for every vehicle and task, and a mismatched weight can even raise power. This paper instead formulates energy-efficient underwater control as a constrained Markov decision process in which average thruster power is subject to an explicit budget, solved with a PPO-Lagrangian algorithm. The power level is set by declaring a budget in physical units, and a single dual variable is updated online to meet it for each vehicle and task, without manual weight search. Across three vehicles and four tasks in the MarineGym simulator, the energy-constrained policy draws the least power in all twelve settings, reducing it by 14--65\% (up to 64.9\%) over a task-only baseline and below an energy-reward baseline everywhere, while remaining the smoothest in ten settings and preserving task accuracy except in one deliberately power-limited regime. Imposing energy as an explicit constraint thus offers a tuning-free route to energy-efficient underwater control that needs no per-vehicle, per-task weight search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将节能水下控制建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程，使用PPO-Lagrangian算法显式约束平均推进器功率，无需手动调参即可在多个车辆和任务中实现14-65%的能耗降低，同时保持任务精度。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习水下控制器仅优化任务精度会导致振荡式耗能，而现有添加能量惩罚项的方法需要手动调参且无法指定目标功率水平，缺乏物理可解释性。
AI.method: 将节能水下控制建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），以平均推进器功率为显式约束，使用PPO-Lagrangian算法在线更新单一对偶变量以满足功率预算约束。
AI.result: 在MarineGym模拟器中，跨3种水下航行器和4种任务共12个设置中，能量约束策略均实现最低能耗（降低14-65%），在10个设置中保持最平滑控制，仅在特定功率受限场景下牺牲任务精度。
AI.conclusion: 将能量作为显式约束而非惩罚项，提供了一种免调参的节能水下控制方案，无需针对不同车辆和任务进行权重搜索。

title: Gastroendoscopy View Synthesis: A New Real Dataset and Evaluation
summary: Novel view synthesis (NVS) is an active research topic in computer vision, owing to the success of neural radiance field (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) methods. While NVS opens the door to potential applications in gastroendoscopy, such as extending the field of view of endoscopic images and enabling digital twins for 3D archiving and endoscopist manipulation training, the dataset is insufficient to evaluate NVS for gastroendoscopy. In this paper, we present the first real gastroscopy dataset for NVS, namely the GastroNVS dataset, which contains a set of gastroscopic images, camera poses, and a point cloud for real gastroendoscopy inspection. To assess the suitability of the GastroNVS dataset, we evaluate several 3DGS methods and discuss the challenges for future development. The dataset is available on request from our project page.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个用于胃镜场景的新视角合成（NVS）数据集GastroNVS，包含胃镜图像、相机位姿和点云，并评估了多种3D高斯泼溅方法，为胃镜NVS研究提供了基础。
AI.motivation: 现有NVS方法（如NeRF和3DGS）在胃镜领域的应用潜力很大（如扩展视野、数字孪生、手术训练），但缺乏专门用于胃镜场景的NVS数据集来支持相关研究。
AI.method: 构建了首个真实胃镜NVS数据集GastroNVS，包含胃镜图像、相机位姿和点云数据，并基于该数据集对多种3DGS方法进行了评估。
AI.result: 成功构建了GastroNVS数据集，并通过实验评估了多种3DGS方法在该数据集上的表现，指出了胃镜NVS面临的挑战。
AI.conclusion: GastroNVS数据集填补了胃镜NVS领域的空白，为未来的胃镜新视角合成研究提供了基准，同时揭示了该场景下仍需解决的难点。

title: SA-LIVO: Efficient LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry with Subspace-Aware Degeneracy Handling
summary: Tightly coupled LiDAR-visual-inertial odometry (LIVO) fuses precise geometric depth with complementary visual measurements, yet its exteroceptive sensors face independent failure modes: LiDAR degenerates when scan geometry is under-constrained, while visual measurements degrade under adverse illumination or texture absence. Existing countermeasures, including binary degeneracy detection, covariance inflation, and scene-level quality gating, operate at the modality level and leave the direction-dependent structure of the joint information matrix unaddressed. Consequently, visual residuals enter pose directions where LiDAR is well-constrained, while in deficient directions visual compensation disperses across the full state space rather than concentrating where needed. We propose SA-LIVO, a LiDAR-inertial-visual odometry system addressing these limitations through direction-selective fusion and information-efficient processing. The Subspace-Aware Information Fusion (SAIF) framework eigendecomposes the joint LiDAR-visual information matrix and applies a linear-clamp soft gate per eigendirection, attenuating degenerate directions while preserving observable ones at full strength. LiDAR and visual residuals are then jointly optimized in one InEKF loop at a shared linearization point. Since visual information contributes only where LiDAR is deficient, photometric Jacobians are assembled once before the loop and reused across iterations, avoiding the per-iteration cost of conventional iterated filters. Experiments on 29 sequences from three benchmarks (HILTI'22, New College, Oxford Spires) and concurrent-degradation scenarios show accuracy competitive with the strongest baselines and bounded drift where competing systems diverge. SA-LIVO averages 12.3 ms per frame on a laptop CPU and 26.8 ms on an embedded ARM board without GPU, with 3.6-6.3x lower peak memory. The code will be open-sourced.

AI.tldr: SA-LIVO提出子空间感知信息融合框架，通过特征分解联合信息矩阵并逐方向软门控，使视觉残差仅在LiDAR退化方向上起作用，在三个基准29个序列上实现高精度、低漂移，且计算效率高（CPU上12.3ms/帧）。
AI.motivation: 现有LIVO系统在LiDAR与视觉各自失效时缺乏方向级应对：LiDAR在几何约束不足时退化，视觉在弱纹理/光照下失效。现有方法仅在模态层面做退化检测或协方差膨胀，未处理联合信息矩阵的方向依赖结构，导致视觉信息在不需处浪费、在需处分散。
AI.method: 提出SA-LIVO系统，核心是子空间感知信息融合（SAIF）框架：对联合LiDAR-视觉信息矩阵进行特征分解，每个特征方向施加线性-钳位软门控（linear-clamp soft gate），抑制退化方向、保留可观测方向。在单次InEKF循环中联合优化LiDAR和视觉残差，共享线性化点。视觉雅可比仅在循环前组装一次，跨迭代复用，避免传统迭代滤波器每迭代重算的开销。
AI.result: 在HILTI'22、New College、Oxford Spires三个基准29个序列以及并发退化场景中，精度与最强基线相当，且在竞争系统发散时保持有界漂移。SA-LIVO在笔记本CPU上平均12.3ms/帧，嵌入式ARM板（无GPU）上26.8ms/帧，峰值内存降低3.6-6.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于方向选择性融合的SA-LIVO有效解决了LIVO系统中LiDAR与视觉的退化问题，实现了高精度、低漂移与高效率的统一，代码将开源。

title: PRISM: Feed-Forward Single-Image 3D Reconstruction via Geometric Warp-Residual Modeling
summary: Reconstructing 3D scenes from a single image is a fundamental challenge in computer vision, with broad applications in virtual reality, robotics, and content creation. Recent methods achieve outstanding performance by leveraging camera-controlled video diffusion models, but rely on iterative diffusion sampling, which greatly limits their practical deployment. We observe that geometric forward warping alone can cover the majority of a target view directly from the input image, with only a compact residual left for the encoder to correct. Motivated by this observation, we propose PRISM, a feed-forward framework that decomposes multi-view latent prediction into a parameter-free geometric prior and a learned residual correction, with no diffusion sampling required at inference. To enable generalization from purely synthetic training data, we devise a two-stage training strategy combining latents supervised distillation for geometric generalization and perceptual fine-tuning for appearance quality optimization. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that PRISM achieves competitive reconstruction quality compared with diffusion-based methods, while reducing inference time dramatically to only 36 seconds per scene.

AI.tldr: PRISM是一个前馈式单图3D重建框架，通过将多视角潜在预测分解为几何先验和残差校正，无需扩散采样即可在36秒内完成场景重建，性能与扩散方法相当。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的单图3D重建方法虽然效果好，但依赖迭代采样过程，推理时间过长，限制了实际部署。
AI.method: 提出PRISM前馈框架：(1) 将多视角潜在预测分解为参数无关的几何前向扭曲先验 + 可学习的残差校正；(2) 两阶段训练策略：潜在监督蒸馏（保证几何泛化）+ 感知微调（优化外观质量）。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上，PRISM的重建质量与扩散方法相当，但推理时间大幅降低至每场景仅36秒。
AI.conclusion: 通过巧妙利用几何扭曲覆盖大部分目标视图这一观察，PRISM在不牺牲重建质量的前提下，实现了从扩散迭代采样到前馈推理的范式转变，显著提升了实际部署效率。

title: Learning Asynchronous Upper-body Task-space Trajectory Tracking Policy for Humanoid Robots
summary: High-level humanoid planners often output sparse task-space, low-rate trajectories, whereas whole-body controllers run at high frequency. This creates temporal asynchrony between the planning and execution, and structural incompleteness for full-body control. We propose an asynchronous upper body task-space tracking framework for humanoids. A student policy is initialized by teacher-student distillation, conditioned on the full cached future trajectory and an execution-time index, and trained with a sliding-window global reward to reduce frame drift without explicit frame estimation. For task-specific post-training, an MPC module completes sparse references into floating-base and upper-body guidance, while action- and FK level self-guidance constrain policy drift. Simulation and Unitree G1 hardware experiments show improved tracking under low update rates, stronger performance than synchronous and decoupled baselines, and safer adaptation to out-of-distribution motions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种异步上身任务空间跟踪框架，通过教师-学生蒸馏、滑动窗口全局奖励和MPC模块，解决人形机器人规划与执行之间的时间异步和结构不完整问题，在低更新率下实现更优跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人高层规划器输出稀疏、低更新率的任务空间轨迹，而全身控制器需要高频运行，导致规划与执行之间存在时间异步和结构不完整（缺乏全身控制信息）。
AI.method: 1) 教师-学生蒸馏初始化学生策略；2) 以完整缓存未来轨迹和执行时间索引为条件训练；3) 滑动窗口全局奖励减少帧漂移；4) 后训练阶段使用MPC模块补全稀疏参考，动作级与正向运动学级自引导约束策略漂移。
AI.result: 仿真和Unitree G1硬件实验表明：低更新率下跟踪性能提升，优于同步和去耦合基线，对分布外运动具有更安全的适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 异步跟踪框架有效解决了规划-执行异步问题，无需显式帧估计即可减少帧漂移，在现实硬件上验证了实用性。

title: LinStereo: Linear-Complexity Global Attention for Multi-Scale Iterative Stereo Matching
summary: Existing Vision Foundation Model (VFM)-based iterative stereo pipelines under-exploit three information pathways: multi-scale backbone features are collapsed into single-level correlations, geometric priors remain untapped at initialization, and context propagates only locally. These gaps widen under degraded photometric cues, making underwater scenes a stringent generalization test. To address this, we propose LinStereo, built upon Depth Anything V3, whose core is a Position-Aware Linear Attention (PALA) module that replaces local recurrence with global aggregation at linear cost, propagating reliable estimates from well-matched regions into degraded areas while preserving disparity structure. PALA is made effective by two enabling components: Hierarchical Semantic Cost Volumes (HSCV), which supply scale-aligned correlations from the VFM feature hierarchy, and a Depth Prior Initialization (DPI) that converts monocular depth into a metrically calibrated warm start. LinStereo achieves state-of-the-art-level accuracy on standard benchmarks and strong cross-domain generalization, particularly on underwater scene where severe photometric degradation makes stereo matching particularly challenging, attaining the best overall accuracy with consistent gains 28% lower AbsRel on TartanAir-UW, 26% on SQUID, a real-world underwater dataset).

AI.tldr: LinStereo是一种基于Depth Anything V3的立体匹配方法，通过位置感知线性注意力（PALA）、分层语义代价体（HSCV）和深度先验初始化（DPI）三个组件，在标准基准和跨域泛化（尤其水下场景）上达到SOTA级精度，AbsRel降低26-28%。
AI.motivation: 现有VFM迭代立体流水线未充分利用多尺度骨干特征（被压缩为单级关联）、几何先验（初始化时未利用）和上下文传播（仅局部），导致在光度退化（如水下场景）下性能下降。
AI.method: 基于Depth Anything V3构建LinStereo，核心是位置感知线性注意力（PALA）模块，以线性成本实现全局聚合替代局部循环，将可靠区域的估计传播到退化区域。两个关键组件：分层语义代价体（HSCV）提供VFM特征层次中的尺度对齐关联；深度先验初始化（DPI）将单目深度转换为度量校准的初始值。
AI.result: 在标准基准上达到SOTA级精度，跨域泛化能力强。水下场景中：TartanAir-UW上AbsRel降低28%，SQUID（真实水下数据集）上AbsRel降低26%。
AI.conclusion: LinStereo通过全局注意力机制和VFM特征的有效利用，显著提升了立体匹配在退化环境（特别是水下场景）中的泛化能力和精度。

title: Stage-Aware and Roughness-Constrained Diffusion Policy for Multi-Stage Robotic Polishing
summary: Polishing is a critical finishing process in high-end manufacturing fields such as aerospace, where surface quality directly affects the service performance and reliability of components. Robotic imitation learning provides a flexible solution for such tasks, but current methods remain limited in industrial polishing because of long-horizon dependencies, uncertain stage transitions, and the difficulty of modeling and regulating coupled process parameters. To address these issues, this paper proposes a Stage-Aware and Roughness-Constrained Diffusion Policy (SRDP) for robotic polishing. SRDP infers the process-stage posterior from multimodal observation histories and uses it to condition the shared reverse denoising process, enabling stage-consistent action generation without external stage labels during execution. Furthermore, a roughness-oriented process-constrained diffusion sampling method is incorporated to generate constrained feed speed and normal contact force under stage-wise preset spindle speeds, thereby improving process consistency and physical feasibility. Systematic experiments are conducted on two representative scenarios, namely spacecraft cabin coating-surface polishing and inner-cavity structural surface finishing. Comparisons with advanced baselines, ablation studies, and real-robot validations comprehensively evaluate the proposed method. The results show that SRD improves stage-transition stability, process-parameter consistency, and final surface quality across different polishing scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种阶段感知与粗糙度约束的扩散策略（SRDP），用于机器人抛光。该方法通过多模态观测历史推断加工阶段后验，并利用粗糙度导向的约束扩散采样生成符合物理可行性的进给速度和法向接触力。在航天器舱段涂层抛光和内腔结构表面精加工两个场景中的实验表明，SRDP在阶段转换稳定性、工艺参数一致性和最终表面质量上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 高端制造中的抛光任务面临长程依赖、阶段转换不确定以及耦合工艺参数难以建模与调控等挑战，现有模仿学习方法在这些问题上表现有限。
AI.method: 提出SRDP框架：1）从多模态观测历史推断加工阶段后验，并以此条件化共享的逆向去噪过程，实现无需外部阶段标签的跨阶段一致动作生成；2）引入粗糙度导向的工艺约束扩散采样方法，在阶段预设主轴转速下生成受限的进给速度和法向接触力，提升工艺一致性与物理可行性。
AI.result: 在航天器舱段涂层抛光和内腔结构表面精加工两个代表性场景中，通过与先进基线方法对比、消融实验和真实机器人验证，SRDP在阶段转换稳定性、工艺参数一致性和最终表面质量上均取得更优结果。
AI.conclusion: SRDP有效解决了工业抛光中长程依赖与阶段不确定性问题，通过阶段感知扩散和粗糙度约束采样提升了工艺一致性与表面质量，在不同抛光场景中均表现优越。

title: C3-Bench: A Context-Aware Change Captioning Benchmark
summary: While Change Captioning systems have garnered substantial attention to respond to our evolving world, their true performance on diverse real-world change contexts remains largely unexplored due to the lack of comprehensive evaluation frameworks. To fill this gap, we propose C3-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating Context-aware Change Captioning. C3-Bench features: (1) 4,996 human-labeled image pairs of 51 real-world change contexts across four domains (e.g., natural scenes, remote sensing imagery, image editing, and anomalies), each with diverse, carefully curated scenarios derived from multiple change-centric communities; and (2) the first LLM-as-Judge evaluation framework in the change captioning task that measure fine-grained dimensions (e.g., correctness, specificity, fluency, and relevance), along with a novel reversibility metric exploring whether models understand changes with symmetric consistency. Based on C3-Bench, we benchmark 32 models -- including conventional change captioning models, proprietary Large Multimodal Models (LMMs), and 2B-90B open-source LMMs. We reveal a fundamental blind spot in the prevailing change captioning paradigm: Once the change context departs from training-style regimes, conventional models collapse, and even state-of-the-art LMMs such as GPT-5.2 exhibit systematic domain- and position-dependent errors that distort reliable change understanding. By making these hidden failure modes explicit and measurable, we delineate the next frontier for building generalizable and trustworthy change captioning systems. All codes and datasets are publicly available on the project page.

AI.tldr: 本文提出C3-Bench，一个面向真实世界多样变化上下文的全面评估基准，包含4,996对人类标注图像对、51种变化上下文、首个LLM-as-Judge评估框架及新颖的可逆性度量，并对32个模型（传统模型、专有LMMs、开源LMMs）进行基准测试，揭示了现有变化描述系统在脱离训练风格时的系统性盲点。
AI.motivation: 现有变化描述系统虽受关注，但其在多样化真实世界变化上下文中的真实性能尚未被充分探索，缺乏全面的评估框架来揭示模型的局限性。
AI.method: 构建C3-Bench基准，包含4,996对人类标注图像对、51种变化上下文（涵盖自然场景、遥感、图像编辑、异常四个领域）；提出首个LLM-as-Judge评估框架，在正确性、特异性、流畅性、相关性等细粒度维度上进行评估，并引入新颖的可逆性度量来检验模型对变化理解的对称一致性。
AI.result: 对32个模型（传统变化描述模型、专有LMMs、2B-90B开源LMMs）进行基准测试，发现一旦变化上下文偏离训练风格，传统模型完全崩溃，即使是GPT-5.2等最先进LMMs也表现出系统性的领域依赖性和位置依赖性错误。
AI.conclusion: 通过将隐藏的失败模式显式化、可度量，为构建可泛化、可信赖的变化描述系统指明了下一个前沿方向。

title: StairMaster: Learning to Conquer Risky Hollow Stairs for Agile Quadrupedal Robots
summary:
Climbing hollow stairs remains a challenging problem for quadruped robots due to the high risk of leg trapping, severe depth sparsity, and high-frequency depth-sensing noise. In this paper, we propose StairMaster, a novel three-stage reinforcement learning framework for stable locomotion on such extreme discontinuous terrains. Our architecture integrates a Cross-Attention mechanism to extract structural features from noisy depth data, alongside a Spatial-aware Recurrent Unit (SRU) that maintains robust spatio-temporal memory to mitigate perception blind spots. To bridge the sim-to-real gap in depth perception, we propose a high-fidelity sim-to-real depth sensor modeling pipeline that faithfully replicates real-world sensor artifacts. Additionally, we employ a 3D waypoint-guided active perception reward for proactive sensing, alongside hollow gap kinematic and stair edge penalties to ensure precise foothold placement. We successfully deployed StairMaster on a Unitree Go2 robot, demonstrating its ability to conquer hollow stairs with an unprecedented incline of up to 55$^\circ$ through zero-shot transfer. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first RL-based policy to achieve such steep hollow stair climbing in real-world environments.
  Project Website: https://sivan666666.github.io/StairMaster/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StairMaster，一种三阶段强化学习框架，使四足机器人在高达55°倾斜的空心楼梯上实现稳定攀爬，首次通过零样本迁移在真实环境中完成此类任务。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人攀爬空心楼梯面临腿卡陷、深度信息稀疏和高频噪声三大挑战，现有方法难以应对这种极端不连续地形。
AI.method: 提出三阶段RL框架：1) Cross-Attention机制从噪声深度数据中提取结构特征；2) 空间感知循环单元(SRU)维持鲁棒时空记忆；3) 高保真度仿真到现实深度传感器建模管道；4) 3D路标点引导的主动感知奖励；5) 空心间隙运动学与楼梯边缘惩罚。
AI.result: 在Unitree Go2机器人上成功部署，零样本迁移实现最高55°倾斜空心楼梯攀爬，是首个在真实环境达到此性能的基于强化学习的方法。
AI.conclusion: StairMaster通过创新的感知-记忆-奖励设计，首次实现了RL策略在真实环境中攀爬陡峭空心楼梯，有效弥合了仿真到现实的感知差距。
